My client, Rebecca Lorenz, a 71-year-old great-grandmother and nurse, followed a peaceful group into the Capitol on January 6th. She didn't speak a word while inside the building for 10 minutes. She prayed in silence and walked with the group.

Two years later, Rebecca turned herself in to Federal Marshals. She was treated like a violent and dangerous criminal: handcuffed with a belly chain around her waist and placed in ankle chains.

Through my organization, the National Constitutional Law Union (NCLU), I represented her to the best of my ability, returning to my Harvard Law roots. Still, the verdict would have been the same regardless of my effort.

This was a disgusting show trial. The Department of Justice followed the same playbook as the other J6 trials. They obstructed, deceived, and placed Capitol Hill Police on the stand to literally shed tears about their fear on January 6th of the “Praying Grandma.”

We cannot give up the fight for Rebecca and must move on to the appeal process. **[But I need your help to keep going. Will you make an emergency donation today to help with Rebecca's appeal and defend the other American patriots that the corrupt Biden Administration is unjustly targeting?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJx0jzHPnDAMhn-N2UDBCeS7gaEt4hsqde9UmSR3lwonXEiK-PcV6NStox8_fm0Tr4u_HwPor4D49HYDRJBfAPH1c-dUfvP3z_pT2aN-9T-4O7v4DRDzsbp_6julcUx-OakeKzvIuxWqckOrW-yk0i1Wz2GWN2luN61dN5Mg3SunNN4Utmp2SpvKDyhQCSU-hBASVSNa69ru3n-g7JTQFpS49jTELnlD7ZZ3SilGbkzkahmeOa_bddgEOG3OlOSa3Yfk7GkAToGyj4GW2sSwZZ_Lu1xor0vwMQBOa6LDh0f9SBQsU_3HJetNrnmurwyQU8n8a4slGQdy_I8P2J8aO-sLgxzP2YsY4pX8I4AceX6z7NLp7KkF7IljCRnkiF2VBrvufln81mtQ4nH9byL_DQAA__8WtI9g)**

**Rebecca will be sentenced on August 12 th. She faces a sentence of up to three years in federal prison and fines of up to $210,000.**

My job before then is to pour myself and NCLU's staff into defending Rebecca's character. She has never been in any type of trouble and has no criminal history. On January 6th, she damaged nothing inside the Capitol—she didn't even make a sound!

Regardless of the sentencing, the guilty verdict imposed on Mrs. Lorenz is nothing more than political payback by Biden and the Deep State bureaucrats in the federal government who believe their job is to control the American people, not SERVE the American people!

We must appeal ANY sentence imposed on Rebecca, but it will cost us tens of thousands of dollars. **[So please, donate as much as you can today](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJx0jzHPnDAMhn-N2UDBCeS7gaEt4hsqde9UmSR3lwonXEiK-PcV6NStox8_fm0Tr4u_HwPor4D49HYDRJBfAPH1c-dUfvP3z_pT2aN-9T-4O7v4DRDzsbp_6julcUx-OakeKzvIuxWqckOrW-yk0i1Wz2GWN2luN61dN5Mg3SunNN4Utmp2SpvKDyhQCSU-hBASVSNa69ru3n-g7JTQFpS49jTELnlD7ZZ3SilGbkzkahmeOa_bddgEOG3OlOSa3Yfk7GkAToGyj4GW2sSwZZ_Lu1xor0vwMQBOa6LDh0f9SBQsU_3HJetNrnmurwyQU8n8a4slGQdy_I8P2J8aO-sLgxzP2YsY4pX8I4AceX6z7NLp7KkF7IljCRnkiF2VBrvufln81mtQ4nH9byL_DQAA__8WtI9g)** to help defend this kind woman and help keep her with her family and outside of the walls of a federal penitentiary.

**[Any amount you can provide will be greatly appreciated!](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJx0jzHPnDAMhn-N2UDBCeS7gaEt4hsqde9UmSR3lwonXEiK-PcV6NStox8_fm0Tr4u_HwPor4D49HYDRJBfAPH1c-dUfvP3z_pT2aN-9T-4O7v4DRDzsbp_6julcUx-OakeKzvIuxWqckOrW-yk0i1Wz2GWN2luN61dN5Mg3SunNN4Utmp2SpvKDyhQCSU-hBASVSNa69ru3n-g7JTQFpS49jTELnlD7ZZ3SilGbkzkahmeOa_bddgEOG3OlOSa3Yfk7GkAToGyj4GW2sSwZZ_Lu1xor0vwMQBOa6LDh0f9SBQsU_3HJetNrnmurwyQU8n8a4slGQdy_I8P2J8aO-sLgxzP2YsY4pX8I4AceX6z7NLp7KkF7IljCRnkiF2VBrvufln81mtQ4nH9byL_DQAA__8WtI9g)**

Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponents want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponents – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We already scared off Lauren Boebert. Last year, I came just 546 votes shy of defeating her and winning this seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**

Remember walking around wondering what the heck just happened and being twice as worried about what was to come? Well we do, and that’s why today we’re asking: If you knew that a $25 donation meant that we’d never have to go back -- that we’d never have to feel that way again -- wouldn’t it be worth it? If you knew that by contributing $25, Donald Trump would never return to the White House and as a two-time loser fade into obscurity, never to be heard from again, wouldn’t it be the best $25 you ever spent? If you knew that $25 would help defend our democracy from the MAGA extremists who work overtime to rig the game to protect their power, wouldn't it be worth it? That’s what we are asking for -- that is what the President and this team needs from you if we are going to win this election. By the time you read this, a lot of folks have chipped in $25 of their own. And now they're counting on you to join them. I hope you'll take the time to read this.
| | |
---
Friend, this message is a bit on the longer side, but I hope you'll take the time to read it. **[You see, in a lot of ways, this campaign is a love letter to Florida.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82579272/465736021/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1022-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzQ1NDlmOWItNDJmNS1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=zzKgfrtZEkxSUhBAwwg6rSPe9e6AoKN-uXKY-OQ4F84=)**
I can still remember the first time that I came to Florida. I was working on my masters degree and had just gotten the news that my beloved father had been killed by a criminal with a gun in Ecuador, where I was born. As I grappled with my grief, I found myself missing Ecuador more than I had in years. I missed its warmth, lush greenery, and close-knit communities that I grew up with. My older sister, Monica, knew our family was struggling, so she convinced me to visit her in Miami, where she had recently moved.
When I stepped outside of the airport, it was like stepping into another world. **It was warm, wonderfully humid, bustling with lively, diverse communities, lush, and all so, so beautifully green.** We spent the next few days visiting all of Monica's favorite places in her new city — the spots with the most beautiful views and the best cafes to get a _cafecito_. The people we met were even warmer than the weather. Everyone was welcoming, friendly, and proud to call this state their home.
I boarded my plane back to my home with a heavy heart but a new resolve. **As soon as I was able, I sold my car and moved across the country to live in a one room apartment in America.**(My mom, always my closest confidant, wasn't far behind.)
Since moving here all those years ago, I've had the privilege to build a beautiful life in the Sunshine State. **I fell in love here, found the community I had longed for, raised a family of my own, and dedicated my career to serving this state.** I've helped protect the Everglades, expanded access to health care, worked for Florida International University, and became the first South American immigrant elected to Congress, right here in Florida.
I've spent my life serving this state and getting to know the communities who call it home. But my opponent, Rick Scott, has spent his career scamming Floridians, lying to voters, and making himself richer. **He wants you to think that Florida families agree with his extreme, hateful agenda._But I can promise you, friend, that couldn't be further from the truth._**
Listen, my campaign is deeply personal because of my love for this state — and more importantly, because of what it will mean for my fellow Floridians. Rick Scott wants to sow division and undo decades of meaningful progress. He wants to destroy reproductive rights, gun safety laws, and vital public services, like Medicare and Social Security, that support millions of his constituents, including my own mother.

Florida is ready for a change — I hear it from voters every day as I travel around all 67 counties. I know this November, Floridians will choose unity, progress, and kindness over Rick Scott's extremist agenda.

But the truth is, we're up against a mega-millionaire who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time. If we're going to break through Rick Scott's lies, build unstoppable grassroots momentum, and win this critical race, I'll need your help.

**[Please, will you donate $5 (or whatever you can spare today) to help me defeat Rick Scott and give our home the leadership that we deserve? name: Jon Tester
subject: Can I explain something?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Can I explain something, folks?

I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.

**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**

Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.

I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.

The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy — but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.

**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with Republican special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

[**That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $10 between the Voter Protection Project and my campaign today to help us defend Montana’s Senate seat. Anything you can give makes a difference.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/65523?t=6&akid=13697%2E878179%2E4JQW4Z) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/65524?t=7&akid=13697%2E878179%2E4JQW4Z)

Your weekly rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| | [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
| **April 7, 2024**
# **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
### By Heidi Ganahl
---
| Hello, It was a wonderful weekend spent with patriots from across the state at the GOP State Assembly in Pueblo! We met so many of you, whether it be at our event Friday night or at our booth all day Saturday, who are in the fight for freedom. If you’re new around here, we’d like to welcome you! Please let us know if you have any feedback, stories you’d like us to cover, or if you’d like to be a contributor — you can always reply to any of our emails or shoot us a message on social media.

Speaking of the assembly, here’s some highlights from the weekend. We’ll be featuring a story this week with a more in-depth look on what was voted on and how it’s impacting you, the Colorado voter.

* Republican Party delegates from across Colorado's 4th Congressional District convened at the State Fairgrounds first thing Friday morning. Chair [Tom Weins opened](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by emphasizing the significance of the electoral process and invoking the legacy of President Ronald Reagan, urging delegates to consider the district's future while reflecting on its historical commitment to self-government and freedom.

* **The 4th Congressional District Results:**[Lauren Boebert emerged victorious](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), garnering her 40.8% of the votes and securing her place on the Republican primary ballot for the U.S. House [despite facing recent surgery](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Jerry Sonnenberg and Richard Holtorf secured 18% and 15% of the vote, but can still appear on the ballot pending approval of their petitions. However, Ted Harvey fell short of the 30% threshold required to advance to the ballot.

* **The 3rd Congressional District Results:**[Stephen Varela and Ron Hanks](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) secured 33.5% and 32% of the delegate vote. Carbondale investor Russ Andrews garnered nearly 18% of the vote, pending certification of his petition signatures. Delta County business owner Curtis McCrackin is already on the ballot, while candidates Jeff Hurd, Joe Granado, and Lew Webb [await approval of their petition signatures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by the Secretary of State to join the race.

* Lauren Boebert introduced **Florida Congressman Matt Gaetz** , [the weekend's keynote speaker](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with a fiery speech attempting to align Colorado Republicans in this election year. Gaetz criticized Democratic officials like Secretary of State Jena Griswold and Governor Jared Polis while advocating for a return to pre-COVID economic prosperity and supporting Trump-era policies. Gaetz emphasized the importance of [standing with Trump ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)to preserve the nation's greatness and maximize its potential in areas like oil and gas production.

* Christy Fidura, Laurel Imer, and Vera Ortegon were among those who delivered compelling speeches as they vied for **National Republican Committeewoman**. Fidura won with 1,100 votes. Ortegon received 241 votes and Imer received 630 votes.

* Lastly, there was some drama in the press area, when the state party had [Colorado Sun journalist Sandra Fish removed by law enforcement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for biased reporting.

Stay tuned for more updates and insights from the Colorado political landscape in this week's Mountain Minute.

Have a great week ahead,
Heidi Ganahl
---

|

|

|

# STATE
[**Likely voters hold pessimistic view toward state’s future, government in poll entering election year**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A large swath of voters may be concerned with the direction of the state and with items ranging from tax burden to cost of living and education, painting a pessimistic picture in an election year, a poll conducted in late 2023 finds.
**[Colorado Senate compromises to strengthen human trafficking laws, proposal heads to governor’s desk](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Human trafficking, particularly of children, has been a hot and divisive topic at the state Capitol this year. But a bipartisan group of lawmakers has found a way of putting more teeth into the state’s laws by agreeing to a compromise that meant giving up a major provision but ultimately securing a proposal’s passage.
[**Faith Winter, a top Senate Democrat, seeking treatment after appearing intoxicated at Wednesday meeting**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Assistant Senate Majority Leader Faith Winter, the No. 3 Democrat in the Colorado Senate, is seeking medical treatment for substance abuse, she told The Colorado Sun on Thursday. **[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
# NATIONAL
**[With or without Kennedy, Trump would defeat Biden in 6 of 7 swing states, poll finds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A federal effort to register voters using the government’s vast reach, including throughout the U.S. prison system, is raising concerns from critics who have said it won’t benefit Democrats and Republicans equally.
**[Voters express concern over mail-in ballots after major postal office delays](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Voters have expressed concern over the speed of the United States Postal Service, which has seen significant delays in recent months, as the country prepares for the 2024 presidential election.
**[House lawmakers want to put President Donald Trump’s name on major airport](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [TOWNHALL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Visitors to Washington, D.C., could be landing at Donald J. Trump International Airport if a group of House Republicans gets their way. Led by House Majority Deputy Whip Guy Reschenthaler (R-PA), a bill in the lower chamber seeks to put the 45th president’s name on Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) outside the nation’s capital. [**READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
# LOCAL
**[‘Time to pay up’: Calf in Grand County was killed by wolf attack, Parks& Wildlife officials confirm](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE, WESTERN SLOPE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**A calf in Grand County has been killed by a wolf reintroduced to the state, Colorado Parks and Wildlife officials confirmed Wednesday. Following voter approval and much angst from ranchers across the state, CPW officials reintroduced a pack of wolves in December, a process in itself which drew ire from lawmakers and others.
**[A new plan for the Stanley Hotel in Estes Park: Sell it to the State of Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SUN, ESTES PARK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**The deal to sell the Stanley Hotel in Estes Park to an Arizona nonprofit has faded, so the state of Colorado is stepping in with a plan to buy the hotel.
**[Efforts to close Boulder Airport stunted by community support, federal requirements](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE, BOULDER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**A small single-engine aircraft approaches Hep Ingram’s house in northeast Boulder recently, clawing for altitude. Its engine screams in defiance of gravity. And ever so slowly, it drifts closer and closer to flying right over the top of Ingram’s home. **[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
# COMMENTARY
**[Devotional: What’s your priority in life, a destination or simply a dream?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Have you stopped to ponder how your worldview shapes life? It’s a fascinating concept that provides insight into whether you’re on the right path.
**[Giordano: America’s woke education is fueling the mental health crisis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**According to a new Gallup poll, “happiness” is plummeting in America, adding to the mounting evidence that the U.S. has a mental health crisis on its hands. It is particularly alarming that these bleak findings include children, teens and young adults – demographics that have traditionally enjoyed relatively carefree lives and positive outlooks as they face a lifetime of promises.
**[Sloan: Biden’s betrayal of Israel in war with Hamas](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Back in October, in the stunned aftermath of the worst collective massacre of Jews since the Holocaust, Presideent Joe Biden told the Israelis and the world that the U.S. would stand by them. [**READ MORE COMMENTARY**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming a RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
# 🤔 DID YOU KNOW?

The Grand Mesa is known as the **largest flattop mountain in the world**. Spanning hundreds of square miles and standing more than 10,000 feet above sea level, the Grand Mesa is home to various wildlife, distinct geologic features, a national forest, beautiful views, and a national scenic byway.

## Israel Pulls Troops From Southern Gaza
Israel on Sunday said it had [withdrawn most of its army](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGSrCAQRb8Gs7awwVEDgpeYzUs3tBBa7V0UC5ixZr9-azbe9N7knPNxn-6WAx_rf7uTKUucrCv8pElDD6gnXXmzECGpikzTNdj2Sg262oxVrXJzZ2cnG4uEvuuwl0s396h67bBigxK11LKXQ3tTt9o1NFMvBz271js5CC3Jc4mp_ox8lI2W8IpPSrWLexXMVsqZhfoncBQ4XtdVJ3oUSvn9v5eYghc47ux9ICCbi8CRc7IUGHYOXGx6wcVl88leGfaYC6wpPg4PJcV4ZsjxUTZKB6z220I-4xflk1KOB2T7yvA2AKlBdgLHKhl_XhwC51sntFx3y-EXtvxV7icAAP__ZMtyag) from southern Gaza, leaving just one brigade as it and Hamas sent teams to Egypt to begin another round of ceasefire talks. The Israeli Defense Force said it had concluded its months-long operation in the city of Khan Younis, leaving unclear the [future of the long-term offensive](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOhCAUheGnwQ6DcEUpKLaxm223NIiX8W5QDDBjZp9-M1tvd5KvOfm_bvPNUaTj_ul2tDWk2flKT5yBj1zCDM1qA6JE1aDthk72o1IGms163RsdAnSLUcEtfacHvQZlxmAW4cA3ZKWQIECMwvRa6dZ3uOAoDCy-X70wDASuVFNuvxMddcMQX-mJufVpb6Ldaj0LUx9MTkxO13W1x-IPvMrbmZze8w0px5XJiUp2GInvFKm6_OLnI8bCa07pLLykR90wH_zufhzP_nAd6KGHJtv1vChGKnpgIO67o_h3oP5X4zcAAP__1EdizQ) against Hamas. Israeli officials spoke of an upcoming mission in Rafah, where more than 1 million Palestinians are sheltering near the Egyptian border. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said again Sunday [there'd be no ceasefire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFuwyAUgOHT4A3rGTA2A0MXtnTtaGF4xFTYRECC2tNX7dwT_L--j9t2szHF6_5uT9Qt5M26Fl-4CbpSJjYxeB0QGfIB9bRMbF45V2I4tArcz3NwO6zMc--DW5xSs5LcTV5aNUTNgAkQsIKaJZejm3DHFZTY3ewdKCIAfWy5jJ85Xu3AkL7yC8vo8jkkfbT2qIS_EWYIM7330e5uvLCN9kmYubBXwsxvg4KgsBBmYi0WE-2xHb7YXmkrOT8qDSWftOZnO7Bc9G6_LWFmAi4XpUAORftHjynFKhci4H7amP4m2n8iPwEAAP__TXNg_g) without the release of the remaining hostages.
## Biden Might Not Appear on Ohio Ballot
President Biden's official nomination for president may happen too late for [him to appear on Ohio's general election ballot](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1urDAQRp_GdEa2MX-Fi9vQ7W1TInsYw0TGRjBZtG8fbYpUqT99Okfn4zE_PCXK63-_o-NYZg9MT5ytHKSxs60WFxENNhU63WvTDk0z2mpzKqCNemj6YNuodYtgIWoDXvmoAXVFzihjlVWDGtuu6WrQGHBQow3QLqBGYRUuxOWsPwtl3jCmV3niWUPZq-Q25uMSzT9hJmGm-77rHCDjfb13YaajJGKCS5jpDZKYEJhKFmYKtGCWu39JPstXSChXZKa8yrJRueSKGU-ffi8y-JQKyxOy17brVVedbjluSomurhdWrbun9CPGf1X6DgAA__9yoGrl), according to Ohio Secretary of state Frank LaRose. Ohio state law requires certifying candidates for its presidential ballot by Aug. 7. However, the Democratic National Convention isn't until Aug. 19 in Chicago, too late to meet Ohio's deadline. Rose [sent a letter Friday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQRb_GdBM5xhAoKF5Dl9duicb2ELw79iDjJMrfr5J6-6urc87Xdbli5Jhv_zHRVFdZ0Nf4oMXCAMYutgnTSmSobWg6X86mG9p2tM02kbf6YtrgbD92wzCg1-S0Ro2h7XvXNXEy2lht9aDHrm_7kz-To0GP1vkueD0qqynEKuX0LTHXjVZ-yYPKyUtqeNpq3Q_V_lNmVmZG53vJL7mXIwZ6T5SZMz0PZWYWj6zMLFsUOCpWAsYnJHzBD9EOLgbKsBZJgPtOWGK-gWTI8qDkqIBDZqngKdeCDF74ntz9gM8h7iUyvF2aMoX9GZnj0V-U1beEkT-09a90vwEAAP__kUhzAg) outlining this to the state Democratic Party chair. In it, he outlined two ways to fix the problem: change the date of the convention, or have the state legislature change the law by May 9. It's uncertain how easy either would be. Ohio is a ["trifecta" state, with Republicans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFu7CAQgOHTQLcWBmzsguI12-1LupRogLFNhD0WHm20t4-SOhf4f30fj_CAUsux_ocdPS8UIHF5YrC36aZtsDL7BVGjkeh71-thMma2cvN9xOwQ3DDGfsoKADCp7Jako8NslCxeK22VVZOah9GMXeox4qRmG9OQk5qFVZgLU-s-qRy84VJf9MTWJdpl9RvzeQnzT-i70PcItRKfmAt01Fah7-_Q-BUSHdyoBlrC21YoXAyMYf3pHDseLJvP51eptVyjE1atO5T6e-C_uN8BAAD__1nvWgM) controlling the state House, Senate, and governor's office. The Biden campaign said it was "confident that Joe Biden will be on the ballot in all 50 states."
## South Carolina Beats Iowa for NCAA Championship
The South Carolina Gamecocks capped their undefeated season Saturday by [winning the women's NCAA championship](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuOpDAQheGnMZmRKZtbQLAJWW-6ISrbRVPbxkbY06jffsTEEx59ydH_77E8kAPH51_caSprWtAVftNi5CDBLKby00oEpCuamr6BdtB6NNU29Y3v2nEdLKBvFfQKtTVqILAN6dWvFU-gwCijBjW2ne5q15ClQY3GutY7NQqjyHNJZ_0_cSwbreGT3nTWLu1VmLZSjiz0HwGzgPm6rpryEW-8Z9opZulSCPQkaTG_qFgMQcCcSzo_AuZFwMxewKzHYWxb3dyWvsomHZ4pcETpAvKeZXSI0m24H5xi3vi44XxJThdW5-SPi0Pg3PXCqOeOHH4ult96fQcAAP__BBdthw) 87-75 against the Iowa Hawkeyes and their superstar Caitlin Clark. That marks South Carolina's second national title in three seasons, making them the 10th team in Division 1 history to complete an undefeated season. Iowa began the game with a 10-0 lead behind Clark's shooting. She set another record by scoring 18 points in the first quarter, but USC came back and led through most of the second half. Clark had a phenomenal tournament run, setting several records. Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I'm asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=86b25453f4074db69485ae552f41065c&_e=KSAgzIzJNqkAWxy8p5tBBpuBkeixoa5GxFD5XlLo-aMFbMitpeAkbnKRrRSF-GvYK2ABiSFaqNPwZRh0l3RtqiAWCTVGKnWByRwbfQpmqfpCZihzFAg63h0gkT5GStlQFI0JZKkgYZT8LbXwH0puSlo1UVj10kVvMuWkKBUTxyC1CvudTuHP9-3XL_dbGEF2JsMnKsDmMO1LskmN1KGcqpWnb3VVFjCpTh3upNf-WEkxyqo6nqF8uA7IRoaIikgSYWYQHxoRrbW4a5w7q3pofFs2nik-gVCOM_6h5zkhNEWKePFUEczAuYrNnyB4LaFU2XXv-5AGE8hGBYAfcPuCpfVieOWIE5uOm5pwQTui1dz697etmgsZttycX3LN5TkP)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck - and involved the department's helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home - and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver's side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner's life that afternoon - and probably his own. **But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric's case - exhausting his options through the justice system. _Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_ **A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric 's last remaining options for freedom.** **[Now you know why I'm asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=86b25453f4074db69485ae552f41065c&_e=KSAgzIzJNqkAWxy8p5tBBpuBkeixoa5GxFD5XlLo-aMFbMitpeAkbnKRrRSF-GvYK2ABiSFaqNPwZRh0l3RtqiAWCTVGKnWByRwbfQpmqfpCZihzFAg63h0gkT5GStlQFI0JZKkgYZT8LbXwH0puSlo1UVj10kVvMuWkKBUTxyC1CvudTuHP9-3XL_dbGEF2JsMnKsDmMO1LskmN1KGcqpR7eE23EQwktHexpmt1WdDaDtuC2GcaRCOMFjdjxf2CZzJHwo-puPc7ZE9J9E_b94zRTHVR3ecI3VgJVEkVG_bAlzyXKZCVO7CBEJIQRYsVBSQ8fbU46aJIvI5KRPzIyvGyvrIi7_qc6_OlpkYsHczE4VuR7Xe29YthyLXGQ0-Y)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I'm proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund - a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George's County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book - including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect's civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials - in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me - I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones - not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense - but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name. That's why I can't turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. **And I hope you won 't either.** **[**Will you sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Missouri Governor Mike Parson right away?**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=86b25453f4074db69485ae552f41065c&_e=KSAgzIzJNqkAWxy8p5tBBpuBkeixoa5GxFD5XlLo-aMFbMitpeAkbnKRrRSF-GvYK2ABiSFaqNPwZRh0l3RtqiAWCTVGKnWByRwbfQpmqfpCZihzFAg63h0gkT5GStlQFI0JZKkgYZT8LbXwH0puSlo1UVj10kVvMuWkKBUTxyC1CvudTuHP9-3XL_dbGEF2JsMnKsDmMO1LskmN1KGcqo1W5Snvph5Q13L3LldJXoc64Se0wpx42ZeYPLTNyGDW_024vt-LnXE3agWxuLLdMN88iDdAQsGRQqztzllawwcE66ZXtQE0d3EPD8QzT2LOTQvmrEtFYxS5RkkSL3BvOUUS7drXysLmdWsfkC0HSoQCoYNwuXs8zl1tlU0uVpHM)** Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! ---
Many Reasons for Hope
# By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Hello Peter,
Our nation and the world face many problems today, some of which may seem overwhelming, but there are still reasons for hope.
I'm running for Congress because I don't like the direction our country is headed. Open borders, crime, inflation, drugs, violent assaults, failing schools, contention in the capitol, and a myriad of other problems have most Americans saying we are headed in the wrong direction. It can all sound quite bleak, but change starts with hope - the hope that you and I can still make a difference.
Anne Frank wrote in her diary, "How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world." During a NATO assignment to Europe, I visited the home where Anne Frank wrote these words. Talk about bleak; Anne and her family had lost everything and were hiding from evil Nazis who wanted to capture and kill them. Yet, she was able to find reasons for hope.
You and I have many more reasons to have hope. Despite our problems, we still live in the greatest country on earth. Prophets foretold of this "promised land" of freedom and opportunity. You and I have the privilege of deciding if we will "improve the world." It is as simple as being kind to someone, starting with our family, neighbors, and community.
This is why I chose to run for the House of Representatives. According to our constitution, the President represents the entire country; senators represent their respective States. The members of the House of Representatives represent the people. As a Congressman, I can improve the world one person at a time.
As one of 435 voices in Congress, I will fight to fix our country. I will not be able to solve all our nation's problems alone, but I can improve the lives of the people I represent in Boulder City, Henderson, and the east side of Las Vegas.
If someone's Social Security check is missing - I'll represent them. If someone is having difficulty getting their Veteran benefits - I'll represent them. It will be my job to make sure the Federal government is working for the 750,000 people within Nevada's First Congressional District.
To do this, I will be home in Henderson every weekend and whenever Congress is not in session. I will have a robust staff of caring people who live and work here in Southern Nevada. I will be loyal to the Constitution and the people of my District.
Please join me in this mission. As Ronald Reagan said, "You and I have a rendezvous with destiny. We will preserve for our children this, the last best hope of man on earth..."
Together, we will take back our country!
Mark Robertson

*************************************************************************************************

I'm running for Congress because I don't like the direction our country is headed. Open borders, crime, inflation, drugs, violent assaults, failing schools, contention in the capitol, and a myriad of other problems have most Americans saying we are headed in the wrong direction. It can all sound quite bleak, but change starts with hope - the hope that you and I can still make a difference. Anne Frank wrote in her diary, "How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world." During a NATO assignment to Europe, I visited the home where Anne Frank wrote these words. Talk about bleak; Anne and her family had lost everything and were hiding from evil Nazis who wanted to capture and kill them. Yet, she was able to find reasons for hope. CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/canofpeas]
Friends,
When I was a young family doctor working in the hospital, a snowstorm hit the Upper Peninsula and made travel by road impossible.
To get to work, I had to cross-country ski for three miles. I worked a 36-hour shift and then returned home courtesy of the EMS and an ambulance.
When I got home, I remember opening a can of peas. That was my dinner. It was 1 a.m. I went to bed, woke up early, showered, got a ride back to the hospital, and resumed work.
You can count on this grit and work ethic when I get to Congress. Why?
Because we have so
much work to do.
To pass universal healthcare, save Social Security, reignite a labor movement, protect workers, codify Roe, and invest in public education, housing, and childcare, you deserve serious commitment.
As long as I have skis and a can of peas, I'll tirelessly fight for the people of rural Michigan, snowstorms notwithstanding.
First, Friends, I need your help getting there. Your contributions are making it happen. Thank you. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/canofpeas]
-Dr. Bob

And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her. I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zck8925ipn6fh8plkej5hvg581djo8viojphbg78_rp22sh2s8i6ep32clie8p36cph2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. On Message
from Michael B. Moore
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Welcome to our campaign newsletter.
We're happy you're here.
We're using this space to keep you updated on all the latest stories, events, and opportunities related to Michael's run for South Carolina's 1st Congressional District.
Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.
Join our movement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
In the news
The Retail, Wholesale and Department Store Union just announced its support for Michael's candidacy — the first major labor endorsement in the race for SC-01!
As a longtime business leader, Michael knows firsthand that employees throughout every organization deserve fair pay, safe working conditions, and comprehensive labor rights.
From the trail
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Later that evening, Michael spoke at an event with the Sea Pines Blues [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/xYgj4TCLJT9qPDwJ/?mibextid=WC7FNe] .

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On Wednesday, Michael headlined a community event on Daniel Island [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/akReAnLeErq4fKcN/?mibextid=WC7FNe] .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On Saturday, Michael enjoyed some coffee and conversation with the Low Country Liberal Ladies [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/MLCZx5Xawsad8vag/?mibextid=WC7FNe] .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
And on Sunday, Michael attended a Charity Missionary Baptist Church [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/rxPvrpFcmHikGdQ6/?mibextid=WC7FNe] service led by Rev. Nelson B. Rivers.

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhhurkq1sk2k0050o1rgatshjthpngsa31hsr8vo_rp22sh2s8i6ep32clieco76c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztebmhc79g1hr4k4egkuns49jqmh2vonbgogpau8_rp22sh2s8i6ep32clieco76c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

| | | | | Peter, When I retired from the military, I immediately knew what I wanted to do next. During my 40 years of service I had the opportunity to travel the world and experience so much. In the end, the greatest gift was being able to retire back home to Georgia and become a farmer again. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T71273db4-e276-489a-a6cc-db8c4d9c3169/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) My father passed away when I was young but he was a farmer. After he passed, the community stepped up to work our family farm. They took my siblings and I under their wing until we were old enough to handle it ourselves. Those experiences ingrained in me the values of hard work, dedication, community, and love of the land. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8657f36e-47e8-4085-b925-0646ad98df10/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Farming here in North Georgia means dealing with a pretty wide range of demands. Recently, I got a herd of cattle and I’m diving into the work of caring for them from managing their grazing areas to ensuring their well-being. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td7491182-8f4c-4645-9607-5b7eebcd27bd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Growing up on a farm cultivates a strong work ethic, and I’m eager to bring those values to Washington. It is my belief that our nation needs representatives who understand the essence of hard work and commitment. Unfortunately, **a strong work ethic is not something we’re getting from Marjorie Taylor Green** , who currently holds this Congressional seat. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a2fb32a-ef9d-4b8e-bb99-55ba4b4fa32f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) If you agree that we could use more hard work from Congress, I could use your help. MTG, whatever her work ethic, has a lot of powerful and wealthy friends. What I have is a nationwide team of regular people. I know we can conquer this incumbent, but the proof is in the pudding. Together, we can champion those values of hard work, dedication, and community. Your contribution will help us amplify our message and meet voters to make a meaningful difference.

[**Former Iowa Congressman Steve King endorses James Judge for Florida’s 15th Congressional District**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=9564bc1b9d&e=00028e5542)
TAMPA, Fla. – James Judge (R-FL), a war veteran, small business owner and Tampa Bay area native running to represent Florida’s 15th Congressional District, picked up a strong conservative endorsement Monday when former [Iowa Congressman Steve King (R-IA) offered his support for Judge](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=6efb238d8c&e=00028e5542).
“Over the last year, I have had the opportunity to develop a friendship with James and know he believes strongly in our foundational Christian values. James is a committed Constitutional conservative who understands the forces that seek to take down our America,” King said. “I know he will be guided by those values as he works to shrink the size and scope of the federal government, while fighting to secure the border and balance the budget. James is the America-first conservative President Trump called for to step forward, and I encourage the voters in Florida’s 15th Congressional District to vote for him this August!”
Judge, a Coast Guard veteran who served in Iraq with the Coast Guard and later in Afghanistan with the U.S. Department of Defense, is running to unseat Rep. Laurel Lee (R-FL) after former [President Donald J. Trump called for removing Lee from office in late March](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=36e897bb30&e=00028e5542). On Monday, Judge thanked King for his endorsement.
“Steve is a great Christian, conservative American who was run out of Congress by America-last ‘Republicans’ like Lee who also targeted Donald Trump. He was called names because he wanted to make English our official national language and for his fervent defense of our nation’s borders,” said Judge. “What Congress really needs is 435 members with the same set of values as Steve King. I intend to be one of them and gratefully accept his endorsement.”
**About James Judge:** James Judge, a Florida native, graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based public relations, marketing and consulting firm. Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner. The Judges live on a ranch in Pasco County, with their five dogs, three cats, chickens, cows, goats and horses. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also longtime, active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Lutz.

_“Without God, there could be no American form of Government, nor an American way of life. Recognition of the Supreme Being is the first–the most basic–expression of Americanism. Thus the Founding Fathers saw it, and thus, with God’s help, it will continue to be.”_ – Dwight D. Eisenhower

| Hi Friend -It has taken me a little bit to reflect on the wild ride of my campaign – did it make sense to run, what happened, what worked, and what are the takeaways. I spent the last month writing my [takeaways](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6613f33b5dd6935644a5824a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jobyforcongress.com%2Fblog%2Fcampaign-takeaways%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66128bd35f602573f57a89eb%26ss_email_id%3D6613f33b5dd6935644a5824a%26ss_campaign_name%3DThank%2BYou%2B%252B%2BTakeaways%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-04-08T13%253A38%253A27Z&w=6514833727955b66bdb4f35b&c=b_66128bd35f602573f57a89eb&l=en-US&s=jYhG7BF3wV9Mue5gFgP2a_OMoPA%3D). While I’m disappointed with the results, I think Vince Lombardi’s quote that he ‘never lost a game, just ran out of time’ sums up why I am still feeling optimistic. I’m proud of what we accomplished in such a short time.I’m beyond grateful for your support. Whether it was donating, door knocking, texting, or designing, I appreciate how you were willing to step in to help. Thank you. I wrote these takeaways for three reasons:
1. For future candidates - there was so much I didn’t know that I wish I knew. Maybe you can use this as a guide.
2. For my supporters - thank you for following along closely and asking great questions.
3. For myself.

Here is the [LINK](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6613f33b5dd6935644a5824a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jobyforcongress.com%2Fblog%2Fcampaign-takeaways%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66128bd35f602573f57a89eb%26ss_email_id%3D6613f33b5dd6935644a5824a%26ss_campaign_name%3DThank%2BYou%2B%252B%2BTakeaways%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-04-08T13%253A38%253A27Z&w=6514833727955b66bdb4f35b&c=b_66128bd35f602573f57a89eb&l=en-US&s=jYhG7BF3wV9Mue5gFgP2a_OMoPA%3D) to my takeaways.Thanks for being on our team!
JobyPS - if you haven’t been watching, the results of the primary are crazy. Despite low turnout, there was a TIE. Vote counting stopped yesterday and hasn’t officially been certified yet. Sam Liccardo, the former mayor of San Jose, took the first spot with 21% of the vote. And for the [first time in California history](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6613f33b5dd6935644a5824a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.latimes.com%2Fcalifornia%2Fstory%2F2024-04-03%2Fevery-vote-counts-in-silicon-valley-where-two-congressional-candidates-literally-tied-for-second-place&w=6514833727955b66bdb4f35b&c=b_66128bd35f602573f57a89eb&l=en-US&s=9rBuJiPQwWmsJitCpOTdCuXVVtY%3D), Joe Simitian (county supervisor) and Evan Low (state assemblymember) tied for the second spot with 30,249 votes each. Every vote counts!

I’m Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 41 years.

You’ve seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**I’m the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And with this critically important case, I can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.

**[Then I beg you to help me fight for them with your very best gift now of $$25, $50, $100, or even more.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8straqdqnc6fir1kmkajq9jtn2gln5r9334t4u0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32clie1pj0cph2bs)**

I can’t do it without you, Patriot.

Thank you for doing whatever you can **now**.

In Justice,

Larry Klayman

Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots. I think that anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
#

I won’t ever forget it, Peter.
Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.
I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.
And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick.
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even embraces them on the campaign trail.
I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.
I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously.

| | 1\. Our Backbone: Precinct Committee Officers
---
| | Precinct Committee Officers (PCOs) are the backbone of the Democratic Party and the democratic process. They serve two essential functions: 1\. They act as the eyes, ears, and advocates in their neighborhoods (precincts).2\. They participate in the election of party leadership. Currently, we are facing a crisis due to the lack of PCOs. It is estimated that only about 10% of all positions are filled, leaving us vulnerable during this critical election cycle.Please contact us or your local Democratic Party for more information. By providing your address, we can determine your precinct and inform you of the responsibilities and how to become a PCO. It is time to step up to the task and embrace our democratic process with dedication.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/9fOwrC8n5/c?w=xWWXqdXlzNOVM4YE4Am2YO7qIrNh3I7sTgYrcLFvPOs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2EtZGVtb2NyYXRzLm9yZy9sb2NhbC9wY28vIiwiciI6Ijk4NDFkMTc4LWRmNTgtNDk0MS1iYjFkLTFkMzliNWVlMzdhZSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)

| | 2\. The Unacceptable Cost for Dems: far-Right Rural Reign
---
| | The inequity of our election process greatly and needlessly disenfranchises a vast number of people, primarily living in rural areas. Please note that I never write to diminish the great work that Democrats do; I am grateful for every effort. It is my intent to call out areas where the status quo is inequitable and unnecessary. Proving wrong and reversing the assumption within the Democratic party that rural America deserves less is my, and so many others, highest priority.Dismissal of rural America to focus on deep blue urban islands is a relatively new position for the Democratic Party. As recently as 1990, Democratic rural voters helped secure the majority of state houses ([Jeff Bloodworth/ Liberal Democrat](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/9fOwrC8n5/c?w=sXJrNjyOeT0DhsNuo0rlot1S3XyemOJ4rtXjg4RFOH0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubGliZXJhbHBhdHJpb3QuY29tL3AvZGVtb2NyYXRzLXdoby1hcmUtc2hvd2luZy11cC1pbi1ydXJhbD8iLCJyIjoiNTEyZGE3NDItNzIwMC00Njg2LTlhYWYtODUyMGJiYzZkZTYyIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)). However, Democrats now only hold about one-third of state houses. Democratic presidential election campaigns began consciously avoiding rural America during Clinton's era, and by Obama's tenure, rural visits were exceedingly rare.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/9fOwrC8n5/c?w=RrrkmkH3KNjrIbw3sLIJ9h5DbRvZP_NjKYgP1bxx9PY.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93ZWIuZWR1Y2F0aW9uLndpc2MuZWR1L253aGlsbG1hbi93cC1jb250ZW50L3VwbG9hZHMvc2l0ZXMvMTYvMjAxNy8wMi9uY3NsXzE5NzgtMjAxNi5wbmciLCJyIjoiOTZjODU2MDMtZGY5YS00Yjk2LThlYWQtMTE3NDE1ZWY0NWQyIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)

| | Parties in Control of State Legislatures: Courtesy of [Nick Hillman Associate Professor UW-Madison](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/9fOwrC8n5/c?w=HFsR5JnezLawvnONy2mTVXoVNerCXM6uY8wRV07JBMk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93ZWIuZWR1Y2F0aW9uLndpc2MuZWR1L253aGlsbG1hbi93cC1jb250ZW50L3VwbG9hZHMvc2l0ZXMvMTYvMjAxNy8wMi9uY3NsXzE5NzgtMjAxNi5wbmciLCJyIjoiZWFhYTRmM2EtY2I2My00NDZiLWE0MmMtY2UyYmMxMTY5MzkxIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)

| | Why has the Democratic Party stopped showing up? The truth is, I don't think anyone really knows, but there are many opinions. If you talk to the Democratic Party or Democratic campaigns, the answer is standard: not enough votes, not enough money, the cost is too high or our role is to win elections. However, this narrative is false and self-fulfilled by not showing up. By minimizing rural America, the Democratic Party has effectively handed over rural voters to the far-right, allowing them to wield significant political power.
So what is this cost that is too high? It is $1,200, that's it. The estimated cost to get a young or non-Black person of color to vote Democrat is $1,200 ([Politico/April 1, 2024](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/9fOwrC8n5/c?w=pdsPEPfzucTyrbNuvY8zuYnBLOisyg8kaGBimpkWUKI.)). This number represents the worst-case scenario, where the Democratic Party is never present and probably never will be; they are just there to get the vote and leave. We must break free of the election-driven mindset and treat voters as people and not commodities; the cost would likely be far less and loyalty much stronger. Rural Americans United has estimated, based on our pro-Democratic messaging campaign, to be closer to $25 per person, reflecting a long-term strategy of education and trust-building.
---

This amount could fund sixty-seven senate races, 300 house races, or enable 166,667 young or people of color (POC) new voters to vote. You may consider donating to Marcus Flowers, and rightfully so. However, your decision may be influenced by the perceived importance of removing Marjorie Taylor Greene from office. Marcus Flowers spent $16,000,000 in the last election cycle ([OpenSecrets](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/9fOwrC8n5/c?w=Mueu1qdx4-AtRnx4pWyq5Ml_t9KEKqyPG2Ifm1LVYcM.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub3BlbnNlY3JldHMub3JnL3JhY2VzL2NhbmRpZGF0ZXM_Y3ljbGU9MjAyMiZpZD1HQTE0JnNwZWM9TiIsInIiOiIyMWQ4YzBlMC1mNzg1LTRhNDUtYTU0ZS03OTY4ZTJmNjMyODYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ)). This sum is 13 times the total raised and spent by all Democratic Candidates in Central and Eastern Washington’s races (excluding Senate race). His loss is our loss.Putting all money and resources in a single “battleground” race may win the battle, but we may also lose the war.

This is big! | | | | | 1\. Our Backbone: Precinct Committee Officers | | Precinct Committee Officers (PCOs) are the backbone of the Democratic Party and the democratic process. They serve two essential functions: 1\. They act as the eyes, ears, and advocates in their neighborhoods (precincts).2\. They participate in the election of party leadership. Currently, we are facing a crisis due to the lack of PCOs. It is estimated that only about 10% of all positions are filled, leaving us vulnerable during this critical election cycle.Please contact us or your local Democratic Party for more information. By providing your address, we can determine your precinct and inform you of the responsibilities and how to become a PCO. It is time to step up to the task and embrace our democratic process with dedication. | | | | | | | 2\. The Unacceptable Cost for Dems: far-Right Rural Reign | | The inequity of our election process greatly and needlessly disenfranchises a vast number of people, primarily living in rural areas. Please note that I never write to diminish the great work that Democrats do; I am grateful for every effort. It is my intent to call out areas where the status quo is inequitable and unnecessary. Proving wrong and reversing the assumption within the Democratic party that rural America deserves less is my, and so many others, highest priority.Dismissal of rural America to focus on deep blue urban islands is a relatively new position for the Democratic Party. As recently as 1990, Democratic rural voters helped secure the majority of state houses (). However, Democrats now only hold about one-third of state houses. Democratic presidential election campaigns began consciously avoiding rural America during Clinton's era, and by Obama's tenure, rural visits were exceedingly rare. | | | | Parties in Control of State Legislatures: Courtesy of | | Why has the Democratic Party stopped showing up? The truth is, I don't think anyone really knows, but there are many opinions. If you talk to the Democratic Party or Democratic campaigns, the answer is standard: not enough votes, not enough money, the cost is too high or our role is to win elections. However, this narrative is false and self-fulfilled by not showing up. By minimizing rural America, the Democratic Party has effectively handed over rural voters to the far-right, allowing them to wield significant political power. So what is this cost that is too high? It is $1,200, that's it. The estimated cost to get a young or non-Black person of color to vote Democrat is $1,200 (). This number represents the worst-case scenario, where the Democratic Party is never present and probably never will be; they are just there to get the vote and leave. We must break free of the election-driven mindset and treat voters as people and not commodities; the cost would likely be far less and loyalty much stronger. Rural Americans United has estimated, based on our pro-Democratic messaging campaign, to be closer to $25 per person, reflecting a long-term strategy of education and trust-building. | | | | The top four Democratic U.S. Senate candidates running in 2022 raised $200,000,000 more than their Republican opponents (). This amount could fund sixty-seven senate races, 300 house races, or enable 166,667 young or people of color (POC) new voters to vote. If we continue to prioritize one race over another, we risk ignoring the millions of rural Americans living under MAGA rule, which is not a winning strategy. You may consider donating to Marcus Flowers, and rightfully so. However, your decision may be influenced by the perceived importance of removing Marjorie Taylor Greene from office. Marcus Flowers spent $16,000,000 in the last election cycle (). This sum is 13 times the total raised and spent by all Democratic Candidates in Central and Eastern Washington’s races (excluding Senate race). To think that some 246 years ago, George Washington was at the height of his power having just defeated the most powerful empire on Earth. He could have held onto that power as long as he wanted. But, that wasn’t the America he and the American troops of Valley Forge had fought for.
**In America, our leaders don’t hold on to power relentlessly. Our leaders return power to the people -- willingly. You do your duty and serve your country. And ours is a country worthy of service.**
That’s the America I see in our future and I’ve never been more optimistic in our ability to stay true to that sacred cause.
Thank you for being a part of it.
Joe

| | | Donald Trump is just a week away from a criminal trial in NY (for falsifying records to cover up an affair), and he is now [suing the judge](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb098c1bc-b7f2-46d9-a78c-fa3e2313db46/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) in long-shot, last-second attempt to delay the trial yet again. [**Don't let him do it. subject: The Impact of Tech
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=a3881dd6ee&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
A few years ago, some producers approached me about doing a TV show called “The Future of . . . with Andrew Yang.” The theme was I would talk about the future of education one week, healthcare or transportation the next, etc. I thought it could be an interesting way to get some points out and so was glad to explore the possibility. Then, a few weeks later they came back with some mildly surprising data. “So . . . we tested this out with a bunch of viewers, and it turns out that they like you, but they don’t like the future. So we’ll try to think of something else.”

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=423367e91d&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Jonathan Haidt had a new book come out last week called “The Anxious Generation,” that makes a compelling case that social media has been behind the surge in anxiety and depression among young people, particularly girls. He recommends curbing smartphone and social media use for minors and making schools phone-free.

This past week on the Daily Show, Jon Stewart did an extended [segment](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=276d57eaf8&e=0f227c2ae3) on AI coming to replace workers. I received a number of messages saying, “He sounds just like your presidential campaign four years ago!”

If you think about the future, there’s something of a veil of negativity. I wrote in the War on Normal People that we will naturally trend toward either Mad Max or Star Trek in a future of either scarcity or abundance. If you look at movies, TV and the news, it’s clear that most people think our future is more likely to be dystopian than the opposite.

AI is going to change civilization on a scale that may be unprecedented. This week on the [podcast](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=d13aedfefd&e=0f227c2ae3), I interview Jo Ling Kent, senior business and tech correspondent for CBS. She said, “Right now it’s clear that the U.S. and China are developing their own AI domains with different data and algorithms in each. It’s not direct competition so much as two different worlds.”

In the Daily Show segment, Jon Stewart showed various legislators – generally of advanced age – evincing ignorance about how to approach AI. Our lack of confidence in government is fueling the pessimism about the future that many of us feel.

How do you feel about the future? And what would it take to make you optimistic?

When I ran for President I had what many felt was a utopian vision, starting with Universal Basic Income. Most people back then thought it was impossible that our government could send checks to tens of millions of Americans. Then we did a version of that in 2020 and halved child poverty in 2021 with an enhanced child tax credit. The child tax credit fell prey to political dysfunction a year later, but demonstrated that we can meaningfully reduce poverty if our leaders have the will.

Some experts project that AI will increase global GDP by 10% by 2032 – or as much as ~$10 trillion. Where will that wealth go?

What’s ironic is that we are succumbing to scarcity just at the moment when abundance – Star Trek – might actually be a possibility. It turns out that if you don’t believe in government, it’s hard to imagine that the benefits of innovation will be broadly shared.

Why don’t we believe that tech is going to help? It’s because we don’t believe in our leaders. We don’t believe in our capacity to mold our own future. We may not believe in ourselves.

Can that change? That’s the core question on which everything depends.

For my interview with Jo Ling Kent click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=9cab594078&e=0f227c2ae3). To join Forward to reform our political system, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=4328548929&e=0f227c2ae3). For my book on the future we face, “The War on Normal People” click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=6e9d26f3ed&e=0f227c2ae3). It includes a positive vision that we could yet achieve.

---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c46fd324e17941beb1dd938c67a58e1c&_e=jP5jDhRSJIAUbfgMDtf6vzU9aFtoazx39IcqDXLsP_ZlkOFzK7FIqU8bfjMZDADQMxEoniLV_Rr44RXD6QYrG7E4m9IFm7Vvf-oiiYJXriPtn68du-wdnVXrV7N_gv9F7MlYeBSYJpG_9IxQuOT5UQWimtTWY5Q1gY5i-nkzANG8NGBVwK2-f1hdNLPjxTs45VP1JsLwS4m3nqBx2stY0fkp1r3sjctWl_OMRZW2UP-LL-IbFgtSo5mMiyfIsTY1uhsU9_QeHQHn2BNsFik6ASstRbMK5eUZlYvNgI2oVNkvnblnYSBS5glRKpnsBqKmIE0Edrx4Cms4IBbjzlJiChEtpe1DUYHkn8GMTS1bmHFsA767UbOOVd7rCNDCSBPDEUXi2EGCpAoSmA_IJRX23Q%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c46fd324e17941beb1dd938c67a58e1c&_e=jP5jDhRSJIAUbfgMDtf6vzU9aFtoazx39IcqDXLsP_ZlkOFzK7FIqU8bfjMZDADQMxEoniLV_Rr44RXD6QYrG7E4m9IFm7Vvf-oiiYJXriPtn68du-wdnVXrV7N_gv9F7MlYeBSYJpG_9IxQuOT5UQWimtTWY5Q1gY5i-nkzANG8NGBVwK2-f1hdNLPjxTs45VP1JsLwS4m3nqBx2stY0fkp1r3sjctWl_OMRZW2UP-LL-IbFgtSo5mMiyfIsTY1cvCntGkRhq5xgkd_dnZpRBvmZBVM874q9d6Kk_1o5N0Dye5sAK0s6h1xVBHefC8zsE9wojyYx95givRrXT4ovHzUXnAAzu5V0Yk3uWvBjFTJv_a6F9QXnOOs_-4JDbDWULGo7G4QJkMOclejfDp_OQ%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c46fd324e17941beb1dd938c67a58e1c&_e=jP5jDhRSJIAUbfgMDtf6vzU9aFtoazx39IcqDXLsP_ZlkOFzK7FIqU8bfjMZDADQMxEoniLV_Rr44RXD6QYrG7E4m9IFm7Vvf-oiiYJXriPtn68du-wdnVXrV7N_gv9F7MlYeBSYJpG_9IxQuOT5UQWimtTWY5Q1gY5i-nkzANG8NGBVwK2-f1hdNLPjxTs45VP1JsLwS4m3nqBx2stY0fkp1r3sjctWl_OMRZW2UP-LL-IbFgtSo5mMiyfIsTY19PKPdowqmN85WDfyZCfCd5ZUfIAn6W3ti4sCTt-YRmSq2aJHSHncj-KJ4yGI-S0-YJWcSeULTtSy5GKFLokPK0iCPacf47s19_zRR3117bwin4h1X39SojVppxt_5bw2ahmWGNrthYoJT9bHiboaAQ%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

subject: My decision.

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1324%2E135344%2EZHgpCO)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-apr24.UpsRlZ&refcode=em240408-1-15&t=2&akid=1324%2E135344%2EZHgpCO)
---
Friends --
While I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**

clean_body: Friends -- While I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success. The truth is, we all know America is going through something right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple: Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class. Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security. Like protecting our children from the things that are truly harming them. And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream. I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service. But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018. It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions. Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
