name: Stephanie Mohr
subject: Pardoned by Trump
body:
As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump

| |
---
| |
---
Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zruto0v69k0ic21u1smjh59d21kfic1khl2in0l8_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdg66ob2c5h2bs)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage.When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. # [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82614762/465827323/-731719488?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjUyMzY5YS1jMmY1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UKhabymvk_ks8oqMX0aKiCz547KdLz8M6h3x2aWOIXc=)
Peter,

Today, a total solar eclipse will take place across North America and will be visible across the country.

As the former NASA Chief of Staff under President Obama, these eclipses aren’t just an awe-inspiring sight to behold, they are important moments for our science community to learn more about the nature of the universe. In fact, an experiment during a solar eclipse in 1919 helped prove Albert Einstein’s theory of General Relativity!

My wife Loretta and I have spent years educating our community about space, and this eclipse will be a historic event you don’t want to miss out on. They don’t happen every day, so I urge you to step outside today around 11 am PST to witness it – **[you can click here for local timing of the eclipse.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82614763/465827324/1611632849?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjUyMzY5YS1jMmY1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UKhabymvk_ks8oqMX0aKiCz547KdLz8M6h3x2aWOIXc=&emci=73658405-a9f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=8652369a-c2f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=36198509)** Just be sure to wear certified eclipse glasses while viewing.

While California is not in the path of totality, we will still be able to see a partial eclipse. **[Please click here to visit NASA’s website with an interactive map](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82614764/465827325/-1466749812?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjUyMzY5YS1jMmY1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UKhabymvk_ks8oqMX0aKiCz547KdLz8M6h3x2aWOIXc=&emci=73658405-a9f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=8652369a-c2f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=36198509)** of where and when the eclipse will pass through the United States.

I have been lucky enough to have seen two solar eclipses, and they are amazing. Even more, today’s eclipse is an opportunity for the entire country to be united through a shared inspiring experience, and to encourage interest in science and the natural world. Let's make the most of it! For example, you could share your eclipse glasses or pinhole camera (**[click here for instructions on how to make your own](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82614765/465827351/-1436591011?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjUyMzY5YS1jMmY1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UKhabymvk_ks8oqMX0aKiCz547KdLz8M6h3x2aWOIXc=&emci=73658405-a9f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=8652369a-c2f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=36198509)**) with your neighbors or coworkers. Wherever you are, I hope you have good weather and a great eclipse experience!

I hope you will look to the skies today. And remember to protect your eyes with certified eyewear.

Enjoy!

George

clean_body: | = Peter, Today, a total solar eclipse will take place across North America and will be visible across the country. My wife Loretta and I have spent years educating our community about space, and this eclipse will be a historic event you don’t want to miss out on. They don’t happen every day, so I urge you to step outside today around 11 am PST to witness it – Just be sure to wear certified eclipse glasses while viewing. While California is not in the path of totality, we will still be able to see a partial eclipse. of where and when the eclipse will pass through the United States. I have been lucky enough to have seen two solar eclipses, and they are amazing. Even more, today’s eclipse is an opportunity for the entire country to be united through a shared inspiring experience, and to encourage interest in science and the natural world. Let's make the most of it! For example, you could share your eclipse glasses or pinhole camera () with your neighbors or coworkers. I'm not in this race to serve just the people on my side. Congresspeople are elected to represent the entire constituency — left, right, and everything in between, not just half of it.

It's a message of commonsense, reason and sanity, one that fits our unique district. We’re inviting people of all parties to be part of this rural movement.
And, every week I hear from more and more of Bergman’s past-supporters about different ways they feel duped.

clean_body: This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. body:
Our efforts to connect with Hoosiers continued to intensify last week with numerous events, including five Lincoln Day Dinners!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8899c4b390-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_06_03_57&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8899c4b390-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

As we edge closer to the primary election (it's less than 30 days away now!), the momentum of Team Crouch can be felt across the state!

In the past week, our efforts to connect with Hoosiers have intensified, marked by a whirlwind of activity that included five fantastic Lincoln Day Dinners, along with numerous interviews and events!

Let's hit the highlights!

** Early Voting Starts Tuesday!
------------------------------------------------------------

All registered Indiana voters are eligible to vote early in person. Voting locations and hours vary by county. Contact your local clerk's office for details on hours and locations.
Find Your Voting Location (https://indianavoters.in.gov/CountyContact/Index?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8899c4b390-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_06_03_57&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8899c4b390-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** IN THE NEWS: My interview with Tony Katz of WIBC (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9xSb2pqfMO4&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8899c4b390-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_06_03_57&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8899c4b390-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

I️ sat down with Tony Katz of 93.1 WIBC for an exclusive, one-on-one interview about the campaign and my plans as governor. Follow the link below to watch!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9xSb2pqfMO4&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8899c4b390-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_06_03_57&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8899c4b390-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
WATCH (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9xSb2pqfMO4&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8899c4b390-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_06_03_57&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8899c4b390-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Listening Session on the Andrews Water Situation
------------------------------------------------------------

On Monday, I had the privilege of hosting a critical listening session in Andrews. We discussed the town's persistent struggle against harmful contaminants in their groundwater.

It's imperative that every Hoosier has access to clean, safe water. Protecting the health and safety of our citizens must always be our top priority.

** Putnam County Lincoln Day Dinner
------------------------------------------------------------

Later that evening, I attended the Putnam County Lincoln Day Dinner, where I was warmly welcomed by the Putnam County Republican Party.

It was a fantastic opportunity to discuss how, as governor, I'll lead the fight to #AxeTheTax and advance policies that benefit all Hoosiers.

** Johnson County GOP First Wednesday Luncheon
------------------------------------------------------------

Midweek, I enjoyed a delightful luncheon with the Johnson County GOP.

It's always energizing to connect with fellow Republicans who share our commitment to Indiana's conservative values!

** LEAP District Listening Session
------------------------------------------------------------

I'm proud to be the only candidate for Governor who has held a public listening session to hear directly from the communities affected by the LEAP District project.

I share their concerns about the lack of transparency surrounding this project and also IEDC’s lack of accountability.

As Governor, Indiana will have a statewide water plan that addresses water quantity, quality and distribution.

** Indiana United Methodist Children's Home Visit
------------------------------------------------------------

Thursday was a humbling experience as I witnessed the incredible work of the Indiana United Methodist Children's Home, where young people are given a safe and nurturing environment to heal mentally, physically, and emotionally.

This type of care is critical. As Governor, I'll prioritize affordable mental health care for all Hoosiers so our kids don't have to face this mental health crisis alone.

** Bartholomew County Lincoln Day Dinner
------------------------------------------------------------

Thursday evening was marked by the Bartholomew County Lincoln Day Dinner, where I had a fantastic time connecting with Hoosiers!

Special thanks to the Bartholomew County GOP and Chair Luann Welmer for organizing!

** Tour of New Albany, Indiana
------------------------------------------------------------

Friday brought a tour of New Albany, including visits to Open Door Youth Services, Green Valley Soccer Complex, Thrive RCO, and the Indiana Council for Animal Welfare Conference.

** Ribbon Cutting for Southern Indiana FC
------------------------------------------------------------

Exciting news as I attended the ribbon cutting for Southern Indiana FC, Indiana's newest professional soccer team! The club is competing in the United Premier Soccer League and had its season opener over the weekend!

** Harrison County, Starke County, and LaPorte County Lincoln Day Dinners:
------------------------------------------------------------

Friday and Saturday evenings were filled with energy and enthusiasm at the Harrison County, Starke County, and LaPorte County Lincoln Day Dinners.

These gatherings provided valuable opportunities to discuss my plan to #AxeTheTax and how my experience and dedication to Hoosiers set me apart in the race for Governor.

Special thanks to the local GOPs, as well as Harrison County GOP Chair Scott Fluhr, Starke County GOP Chair David Kesvormas and LaPorte County GOP Chair Allen Stevens, for organizing!

** SUPPORTER SPOTLIGHT: Kosciusko County Fish Fry
------------------------------------------------------------

A big shoutout to Team Crouch for their outstanding presence and contagious enthusiasm at last week's Kosciusko County Fish Fry!

These snapshots capture the spirit and dedication of our incredible volunteers, who bring passion and energy to every event!

** Last but not least...
------------------------------------------------------------

I've said it once, and I'll say it again: the grassroots engagement we have across the state of Indiana is absolutely unmatched, and it's all thanks to supporters like you!

With the primary election less than 30 days away, Team Crouch is energized and ready to go! Thank you, Team Crouch!

Onward and upward,

Let's keep the conversation going! Follow me on social to keep up with the campaign. Have questions, comments or concerns? Send me an email!

------------------------------------------------------------
Ready to make an impact? By joining my campaign, there are several ways that YOU can be a catalyst for change! Tap the "Get Involved" button below to get hands-on with the campaign, request yard signs, host an event and more.
GET INVOLVED (https://crouchforindiana.com/get-involved/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8899c4b390-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_06_03_57&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8899c4b390-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Your support plays a pivotal role in our mission to connect with Hoosiers across the state and convey our vision for Indiana's future.

clean_body: 88 new units for military personnel and their families | | | | I worked with my colleagues in Congress to pass a series of spending bills, including a crucial allocation of $19 million for military housing in Snohomish County's Navy Support Complex at Smokey Point. This funding will be utilized to construct 88 new units for military personnel and their families. Not only does this investment ensure accommodation for sailors stationed at Everett's naval base, particularly as it prepares to host a new fleet of guided-missile frigates starting in 2028, but it also underscores the Navy's long-term commitment to the city's waterfront. Together, we are shaping the future of the Everett station, advocating for smaller vessels and identifying new missions to align with evolving global security challenges, including tensions in the Indo-Pacific region. With the transition to the Constellation class frigates, Everett's naval base will undergo significant enhancements to accommodate the evolving fleet's needs. While the number of sailors based in Everett may decrease slightly, the introduction of these smaller, more versatile ships will enable the Navy to extend its presence across the Pacific and beyond. Our continued advocacy will help ensure adequate housing, facilities, and quality-of-life amenities for military installations like those in Everett. name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: This week in Texas - April 8
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

Here’s what Powered by People is working on this week:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fighting for free and fair elections

Some of the most influential courts deciding Texas elections cases are
leaving doubt that they will protect Texans from voter suppression in the
upcoming elections.

In [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63294?t=1001&akid=239545%2E444211%2EMWxRi_ ]a speech that went viral last week, Texas Supreme Court Justice John
Devine echoed Donald Trump’s baseless claims that Democrats plan to rig
his race against Joe Biden.

Here’s what he said in the speech:

“Look at the election law abuse that happened...It’s still out there and
it’s going to happen again. Do you really think the Democrats are going
to roll over and let Trump be president again? You think they’re just
going to go away, all of a sudden find Jesus and [there will] be an
honest election? I don’t think so.”

This is deeply troubling given that Devine is one of the nine Republican
justices on the state Supreme Court who routinely rule on lawsuits
challenging voter suppression.

In addition, the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals is set to [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63295?t=1002&akid=239545%2E444211%2EMWxRi_ ]reconsider
several recent pro-democracy voting decisions that could have major
implications in November.

This includes cases that could weaken what’s left of the 1965 Voting
Rights Act and restore gerrymandered voting maps that had previously been
struck down in Texas.

This means we have to work even harder to protect the right to vote in
Texas. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240408.ocQw6C&refcode=ema20240408-239545&t=1003&akid=239545%2E444211%2EMWxRi_ ]I hope you’ll join me in donating to Powered by People today to
help register and turn out the voters we need to overcome this type of
voter suppression in Texas.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240408.ocQw6C&refcode=ema20240408-239545&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=239545%2E444211%2EMWxRi_ ]CONTRIBUTE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Organizing young voters

As we push ourselves to organize Democratic voters across the state,
Powered by People is expanding our reach on college campuses, where GOP
voter suppression is particularly pronounced.

Our volunteers are on campuses across the state helping young people
register to vote and navigate our state’s restrictive voting laws. We need
to ramp up this work as much as possible before students head out for
summer break in late May and early June.

If you live in Texas, you can help us by becoming a Volunteer Deputy
Registrar (VDR) with our team. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63296?t=1023&akid=239545%2E444211%2EMWxRi_ ]Sign up for a short, virtual VDR
training with us this week and then we’ll put you to work on a college
campus near you.

SIGN UP FOR A VDR TRAINING

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Texting unregistered Texans

If you live out of state, you can still help us reach Texas voters! Over
the coming weeks, we’ll be texting unregistered, likely Democrats across
the state to help them register to vote — and we need your help to reach
them all.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/signup/texting-team/?source=em20240408&t=1024&akid=239545%2E444211%2EMWxRi_ ]If you’d like to join our texting team, please sign up here and then
we’ll contact you soon about next steps.

JOIN OUR TEXTING TEAM

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

I hope it’s a great week for you.

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1025&akid=239545%2E444211%2EMWxRi_

PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE

body:
You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists.

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Speaker Mike Johnson.

_You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists. _

So you can imagine the immediate wrath I faced when I went on record supporting Donald J. Trump for President. I was just talking to my friend, Steve Scalise - he faced the same thing when he endorsed Trump too.

_**[He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we've got to stick together.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a567d13eeccf4aadb8bdb08c40b18a0f&_e=ThMKjkwA7SKga9s8Q7dml3LR-3Q2-rwwrmPg191LdUwEUVfA5yI5kAdP1woTys1qXBAuZLXDpP26LL5jEZOXZubXUj_UIYL4nTUOum3acJ3YN5nzug7HCNiJrXety2B_JdZ8NX6dcTC-6fmveb_4Uitc6Rs2yfLrTYqQGkw7XSUdQjrWhyfz4CyERGj3-DRih2vw82ogYiUJ0jrdYcyT-4hU3sIljtipaOVH-rK-26clJPeGacdvP8zoMzOT18XvM5UNjk6hy_ObFvxp365ht87zh1lrmz5FkI0P3tdtgOGMLeYhyMJfaEHULOOinGRBbWbIqgXo5zHDa62soK2SkV8yakmtTF7iLdhBv7B63kgqw_CEgFSNheKyx-kU4jWuEkKYhRm9gSl60OQDaydFjqi-t2Ki2V2MkmAFEmfukiM%3D "He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.")**_

That's because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden's army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.

But wait, that's not even the half of it. It gets worse:
** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.
I cannot stress the urgency of the situation enough. Early voting is about to start in the first Special Election AND the Left's fundraising advantage grows by the minute...

_**[So as one of my first moves of the election year, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a567d13eeccf4aadb8bdb08c40b18a0f&_e=ThMKjkwA7SKga9s8Q7dml3LR-3Q2-rwwrmPg191LdUwEUVfA5yI5kAdP1woTys1qXBAuZLXDpP26LL5jEZOXZubXUj_UIYL4nTUOum3acJ3YN5nzug7HCNiJrXety2B_JdZ8NX6dcTC-6fmveb_4Uitc6Rs2yfLrTYqQGkw7XSUdQjrWhyfz4CyERGj3-DRih2vw82ogYiUJ0jrdYcyT-4hU3sIljtipaOVH-rK-26clJPeGacdvP8zoMzOT18XvH4UIr_rZzuzfRPfHNljtA-W8uvY3Ot2o40Hn1oKj5aE3cBiJLuol1cb7upRkgDBEotkf4nyzKqihlbWDpMqO9cqK59rC8vpk3qxenucZJinUiFHdTGd5mrByvSbI-Kp3RPFDgDzjdgaWSs6yFThuvqW-RurVvEQJdZlqv8_uvHk%3D "So as one of my first moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

I know, I know - that's a big goal. I get that. But that's as low as I could possibly make it to fully fund our campaign operations in every must-win swing state.

If we fail to hit it, the consequences would be unthinkable. We'd have no choice but to: **1) ** SCRAP our get-out-the-vote operations, **2) ** SLASH the budget for our ad campaigns, and **3) ** Throw our digital outreach plans IN THE TRASH CAN.

Nothing - and I mean NOTHING - would be worse for our plans to defend our razor-thin House Majority. **That 's why I'm calling for reinforcements. **

_I know the economy is in bad shape under Joe Biden. So if that 's preventing you from pitching in $100 or $50 - I completely understand. But if you can afford JUST $10 or even $5, I would be grateful beyond measure. _

_**[I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a567d13eeccf4aadb8bdb08c40b18a0f&_e=ThMKjkwA7SKga9s8Q7dml3LR-3Q2-rwwrmPg191LdUwEUVfA5yI5kAdP1woTys1qXBAuZLXDpP26LL5jEZOXZubXUj_UIYL4nTUOum3acJ3YN5nzug7HCNiJrXety2B_JdZ8NX6dcTC-6fmveb_4Uitc6Rs2yfLrTYqQGkw7XSUdQjrWhyfz4CyERGj3-DRih2vw82ogYiUJ0jrdYcyT-4hU3sIljtipaOVH-rK-26clJPeGacdvP8zoMzOT18XvS7MAj3Wml3tOuup50cdL7Bemnpll1FNrlpTCgg1SR5QiNCH9Re39XB2mbIXSI1XS5yLm9zszSQjjZ8ZFwgHnoz0EKlRUVkp8wqdwt4o_nF9-q-9Qx2EBC7AxFHEphZ10cyf59IixFMvz4oWWEKFlZbFogrHX95kPB0vySQ1EyAY%3D "I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.")**_

When the stakes are this high, that's what will be the difference between saving our Republican Majority and losing to the Trump-hating Democrats. So can I count on you to pitch in SOMETHING?

subject: World War II as you've never seen it before
body:
This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/YjzhxgzqQznq62GT6h-3fA~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars."
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. subject: RSVP to join us and Squad members →
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Over the last three cycles, together and alongside so many, our movement
has been instrumental in building real power in the House through upset
elections to usher in some of the most progressive, working-class
representatives Congress has seen in our lifetime. Representatives like
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Ayanna Pressley, Cori
Bush, Summer Lee, and Jamaal Bowman.

These last six months have devastatingly highlighted exactly why the work
in electing this core group matters and how deeply connected it is to the
fight for poor, working, and marginalized people at home and around the
world. Together more than anything, these incumbents are not only the
moral compass of this movement in Congress, but some of the sharpest teeth
behind it too.

Every member of the Squad is up for re-election this year, and five of
these young, working-class, Black and brown progressives are facing
serious threats to their U.S. House seats: Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush,
Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar, and Rashida Tlaib.

We can’t afford to lose a single member of our progressive bloc in
Congress at a moment like this. We’re facing a challenge like never before
with AIPAC, their Republican megadonors, and other right-wing groups
slated to spend over $100 million against the Squad because they are
threatened by the progressive movement they represent.

That’s why we are launching something big to help re-elect them.

[ https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_fRE2b1CXTcKbhp6I8plbrg#/registration?source=em20240408-34204 ]RSVP today to join members of the Squad, Gen Z for Change, MoveOn, Way
to Lead, Working Families Party, and Justice Democrats for a special
live-stream event on Thursday, April 11!

[ https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_fRE2b1CXTcKbhp6I8plbrg#/registration?source=em20240408-34204 ]RSVP

Summer Lee’s election is in 15 days and we are all hands on deck! You
don’t want to miss this opportunity to hear directly from Summer, other
Squad members, and progressive partners as we announce our next steps to
Protect the Squad in the upcoming Democratic primaries.

I hope you can join us this Thursday!

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

| | Friends,

Congresswoman Spartz is proud to announce that her 2024 re-election campaign has been _endorsed_ by the Indiana Right to Life PAC.

"Whether it is stopping taxpayer dollars from funding abortions or advocating for the religious liberty of health care providers who refuse to perform abortive procedures, _it is imperative to remember that life is at stake and must be defended every time,_ " said Rep.**Spartz,** "I will **never stop fighting** to remind Congress of the value of life – _especially for the unborn_."

**Indiana Right to Life PAC** works to safeguard the right to life through education, advocacy, and promotion of healthy alternatives to abortions.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: All I had was a pen
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
I won’t ever forget it, friend.
Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.
I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.
And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick.
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them.
I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.
I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously.
Please split a donation of $25 — that or anything you can give — between my campaign and Serve America to crush Kari Lake’s campaign and defend our democracy. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
Thanks for your support. As we gear up for one of the toughest elections of our lives, it means a lot to have you behind me.
Ruben

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: World War II as you've never seen it before
body:
This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/H0rkG9bJvN27dhej7Rqafw~~/AARclAA~~~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars."
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/H0rkG9bJvN27dhej7Rqafw~~/AARclAA~~~) If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of "**The Second World Wars** " on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/H0rkG9bJvN27dhej7Rqafw~~/AARclAA~~~)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, '09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. ~~ If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of "The Second World Wars " on DVD: ~~ Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, '09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College Restore Our Nation PO Box 1177 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | ~~

body:
Here’s an update from a week full of conservative wins! | | | | |
---
We are just a little over 200 days away from the November election and our campaign is in full swing. Here’s an update from a week full of conservative wins!
**Local Election Wins** These are some highlights of our biggest-wins in the Spring Election last Tuesday:
1. The **City of Kenosha elected a pro-law enforcement Mayor**. Over the past 6 years Kenosha has trended to the right. This is a testament to the hard work of our great volunteers getting the message out.

2. **We elected conservative prosecutors to the Circuit Court in Walworth, Racine, and Kenosha County**. These judges will keep our communities safe. Our communities will be stronger and more secure because of their work.

3. Wisconsin voters overwhelmingly approved Constitutional Amendment Questions 1 and 2. By approving these amendments, **we’ve banned private money and political operatives from influencing future elections in Wisconsin**.

**My Weekend in Burlington** After Tuesday’s, elections I met with Burlington Mayor-elect, Jon Schultz. It was a great opportunity to discuss how we can work together to address the issues impacting Burlington.
I also stopped by the Burlington Mason Lodge for their Pancake Breakfast. The junior chefs did a fantastic job!
**Seeking Nomination Signature Volunteers** On April 15, my team and I will begin collecting nomination signatures so I can appear on the ballot this November.
If you were ever curious how candidates get on the ballot, here are the signature requirements for public office here in Wisconsin:
Our team will need to collet 1,000 signatures from residents of Wisconsin’s First Congressional District between April 15 and June 1 to ensure I appear on the ballot this November. We’re always looking for more help. If you’re willing to help me get on the ballot, click the link below!
[**Help Me Collect Nomination Signatures**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=39d29ef87e&e=e907534017)

On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

| | | My fellow Americans - this is Speaker Mike Johnson.

_You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists. _

So you can imagine the immediate wrath I faced when I went on record supporting Donald J. Trump for President. I was just talking to my friend, Steve Scalise - he faced the same thing when he endorsed Trump too.

_**[He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we've got to stick together.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=686f5762128444ff9a9b5ec54f62a9fa&_e=FZwaY0pkioglO_Mz1MXIDjm9c3g1fR3JBJ74vyUnNrStZh8UpzXYkd1nF_Ow2TXNa0Z4pUP9mzZDW8YmvPLhtPz0dZDchN2UfUjxYRc8m3JbL-BO0dmbiX0M7tbRLUVOpiKc0yiCXADWbb4m1pwy7bhPkGe0HnVCQ-jblZqOF1bHhZoW-WeVsn_T38oC771qa-EZoloWzQl54-Fw5pVNs2LhZfZoMPBIjxRrlmgt0swU4mj8QVpgs-WmyBqr3QCi1vPczKeOIzJix0UPiijNoMGqYtWtuSIXzuW7HFBSwfwBJmrOrq5QNZHGTq8GQxXS6UV4BWfX6i87LeDEb44uLY2T2O8BdFXfh9LoTrWlWb6UnVjsMw3phcKRLq1dTJqIdXgU0MsCQEIeAxXTCwJi9AqWbJE3HA9n7xCYZ41VOco%3D "He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.")**_

That's because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden's army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.

But wait, that's not even the half of it. It gets worse:
** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.
I cannot stress the urgency of the situation enough. Early voting is about to start in the first Special Election AND the Left's fundraising advantage grows by the minute...

_**[So as one of my first moves of the election year, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=686f5762128444ff9a9b5ec54f62a9fa&_e=FZwaY0pkioglO_Mz1MXIDjm9c3g1fR3JBJ74vyUnNrStZh8UpzXYkd1nF_Ow2TXNa0Z4pUP9mzZDW8YmvPLhtPz0dZDchN2UfUjxYRc8m3JbL-BO0dmbiX0M7tbRLUVOpiKc0yiCXADWbb4m1pwy7bhPkGe0HnVCQ-jblZqOF1bHhZoW-WeVsn_T38oC771qa-EZoloWzQl54-Fw5pVNs2LhZfZoMPBIjxRrlmgt0swU4mj8QVpgs-WmyBqr3QCi1vPczKeOIzJix0UPiijNoCUqhg0Fw4wS-bymUwVwKfuhBpB70_zza2HmdavUmPT6FiuwwerW3NVHuk3acXOhOkcPSb1t2bR2hWN6AaGsr5UM10_ssS7_DCKkw13LZS4PuJ6ga6zV3893fU0nVHI0KHFyuw56u2hWyV7uqhu94-o%3D "So as one of my first moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

I know, I know - that's a big goal. I get that. But that's as low as I could possibly make it to fully fund our campaign operations in every must-win swing state.

If we fail to hit it, the consequences would be unthinkable. We'd have no choice but to: **1) ** SCRAP our get-out-the-vote operations, **2) ** SLASH the budget for our ad campaigns, and **3) ** Throw our digital outreach plans IN THE TRASH CAN.

Nothing - and I mean NOTHING - would be worse for our plans to defend our razor-thin House Majority. **That 's why I'm calling for reinforcements. **

_I know the economy is in bad shape under Joe Biden. So if that 's preventing you from pitching in $100 or $50 - I completely understand. But if you can afford JUST $10 or even $5, I would be grateful beyond measure. _

_**[I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=686f5762128444ff9a9b5ec54f62a9fa&_e=FZwaY0pkioglO_Mz1MXIDjm9c3g1fR3JBJ74vyUnNrStZh8UpzXYkd1nF_Ow2TXNa0Z4pUP9mzZDW8YmvPLhtPz0dZDchN2UfUjxYRc8m3JbL-BO0dmbiX0M7tbRLUVOpiKc0yiCXADWbb4m1pwy7bhPkGe0HnVCQ-jblZqOF1bHhZoW-WeVsn_T38oC771qa-EZoloWzQl54-Fw5pVNs2LhZfZoMPBIjxRrlmgt0swU4mj8QVpgs-WmyBqr3QCi1vPczKeOIzJix0UPiijNoH3FlV2ICQd0xaKR1buGS3xeeJLE50OKavVbQWzEZ1yZ6t8j4-AZwFErRoSSyLhkjnjQeSRo4jEpDH21NmyY2hvVBCSpIIaTrtAv7sGEvb9VSsMe6-0amW6KM0-ryGVR5cq7J_ylZbFW_6YndVy0eF0%3D "I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.")**_

When the stakes are this high, that's what will be the difference between saving our Republican Majority and losing to the Trump-hating Democrats. So can I count on you to pitch in SOMETHING?

subject: Catholic schools facing extinction?

body:
Did you know that nearly 100 Catholic schools...| | | Please see a note from one of our sponsors. If you would like to unsubscribe visit this **[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=16e465d57d9f42de8ffab10ec3d5144e&_t=G8C6Z0s8EA0D75WJK7rRrBD9aE6x1158VQtG3cZ7Al9pFpHqQzW--gB7y16erQ1_SbEjx50qyl8nYB3l2bG6ftKmPs_TJkjYDTIq6qVuen4%3D)**
---
| | **“We’re closing our doors... for good.”** Peter, did you know that **nearly 100 Catholic schools across America** are forced to say those dreaded words every year? We believe every family deserves the freedom to choose where and how their children are educated –– **_and that’s why we’re working to keep Catholic schools open_** _. _
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION: KEEP CATHOLIC SCHOOLS OPEN**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=16e465d57d9f42de8ffab10ec3d5144e&_e=oHeg8_189ApQkO4w7ki0pmRA88rsPU4TJZ29EJ2dCm9AvBdc4m0q4owtKk8IdkVm5z2zPqNgtJ1nrXcBP-1YdRrBiQmEjma7DyoAubD6zQL6-3TB7HbIpi1t1wxSD1lOe2l0m0MG-X4iqNWaT2FnOanMX2AumfD_25QjLJ7rIFbzgFjvv9ma5V5aXlSBLjAPtXA6XsK6Ik9QDN0XW0lFULOH_D3u6ktD5cG9PhWR5Y2q7f_MtaIswaheJ4G7n3TlccF_IwakMdGWbIX3N4H10Ouf_D0VcbaPpfrDSWLMA1Ri9Y1q6Qz-So8O9abMzcTHDlzZ4DaYiZq3_4W7--emcVN3M3LNPEDfaLZ5wRVTjxF-pRyqwpCRhoPtYwyTpNqBYgL3FZWdZLhW-b0fuVMeYYQZHJjElyRTu77A-fJdDc_O0FpaMFTKm3HP18ve0Hc0Lja6KJrGca8cDOtvHlxUZR4HH19NCxtL2iVJJX36bTQ%3D)
---
Right now, 1.6 million American children are enrolled in Catholic schools, but the school system they love is under threat of extinction –– **especially** in states that don’t allow taxpayers to direct education tax dollars to private schools.

For many families, their local Catholic school is the only available alternative to the public school system. **And if their school closes, their access to school choice can disappear overnight.**
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION: SAVE CATHOLIC SCHOOLS**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=16e465d57d9f42de8ffab10ec3d5144e&_e=oHeg8_189ApQkO4w7ki0pmRA88rsPU4TJZ29EJ2dCm9AvBdc4m0q4owtKk8IdkVm5z2zPqNgtJ1nrXcBP-1YdRrBiQmEjma7DyoAubD6zQL6-3TB7HbIpi1t1wxSD1lOe2l0m0MG-X4iqNWaT2FnOanMX2AumfD_25QjLJ7rIFbzgFjvv9ma5V5aXlSBLjAPtXA6XsK6Ik9QDN0XW0lFULOH_D3u6ktD5cG9PhWR5Y2q7f_MtaIswaheJ4G7n3TlccF_IwakMdGWbIX3N4H10Ouf_D0VcbaPpfrDSWLMA1Ri9Y1q6Qz-So8O9abMzcTHDlzZ4DaYiZq3_4W7--emcSv3fImPVxToNVX3h3IFOmN0NRAc29svt0IaBDDS3nxQARFYgK7G1t_Miy4T9tAB6Jpvh2dFpSJU_cJJq4nI9H6wLKStU2HeMfSbVKFXWwnx1j9X1QrRgJzgrnHG0dhqkDsumW1T40CSvjCt5fvOW7Q%3D)
---
**This is the withering of educational options in our most at-risk neighborhoods. **

__Because these schools aren't just for Catholics. __

There's a beautiful phrase you will hear from Catholic educators: "We don't teach these kids because _they're_ Catholic. We teach because _we're_ Catholic."

Catholic schools don't just open where there is existing parent wealth. As a charitable work, they serve many communities where quality education is lacking.

[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=263f7ab915&e=567664f14c)
We're excited to bring you the[ latest episode of the No Doubt About It Podcast ](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=f22f9975a1&e=567664f14c)with Mark and Krysty Ronchetti, and trust us, this episode has it all!
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=fa74919d95&e=567664f14c)
In this episode, we're joined by Kenyon Burns, an oil and gas guy from southeastern New Mexico, who has firsthand experience with the border crisis. We dive deep into the story that people want to continue to talk about...**the outrageous episode of former Lieutenant Governor Diane Denish convincing Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham to veto funding for kids' play equipment at a local park.** Mark's hilarious take on Denish's opposition to kids in the park from last week’s episode have sent in a flurry of comments...which we share on this episode. It’s something you have to hear.
[Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=8622ea443e&e=567664f14c)
We also tackle the serious issue of the border crisis in New Mexico. Border patrol reports that parts of the southern border are now controlled by cartels, and we discuss why this must be addressed urgently.

Get ready for a special treat as we announce Todd Bensman, author of "Overrun," as our guest for Thursday's episode. He'll shed light on how the Biden administration's border policies are impacting everyone.
[Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=7a3b61cfe8&e=567664f14c)
Plus, Mark addresses New Mexico's clean car rules and their potential impact on local car dealers, urging them to stand up and fight back.
And to wrap things up, we have a light-hearted discussion about what we would do if a plane we were on experienced engine failure – Krysty's response will leave you chuckling!

➡ [**STREAM EPISODE NOW**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3549704a61&e=567664f14c)

bombs to Israel — even after Netanyahu’s war has killed over 30,000
Palestinian civilians and 200 aid workers — Bernie continues to call for
end to U.S. support for this horrific conflict, like he did on MSNBC this
week:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16548?t=1011&akid=5738%2E5885482%2EiQ4gaj ][IMG]

How can the Biden administration justify sending more bombs to Israel,
when U.S. bombs have already killed so many civilians in Gaza? It can’t be
justified and we must amplify our calls alongside Bernie to end U.S.
support for this war.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16546?source=email-20240408&t=1012&akid=5738%2E5885482%2EiQ4gaj ]Stand with Bernie: No more weapons and not another nickel to support

last week. The head of the aid group, José Andrés, says it was a direct
targeted attack. And Bernie is rebuking Netanyahu’s claim that the attacks
on aid workers was an accident.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16548?t=1014&akid=5738%2E5885482%2EiQ4gaj ][IMG]

conflict.

Netanyahu’s war machine,” Bernie said in his MSNBC interview. If Biden
doesn’t change his morally bankrupt policies in Gaza, more civilians and
aid workers will die, and he’s risking losing the election in November to
Trump.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. Friend,
We have concerning news: A witness before Congress said she opposes ANY restrictions on abortion and tried to erase the word "Mother."
She said the proper terminology was "birthing persons" rather than mothers. A woman’s greatest gift is her ability to give life to an unborn child, and now they’re trying to take that away from them. It is truly UNFATHOMABLE.

| [ **REJECT THE TERM BIRTHING PERSONS** ](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kLuu2zAQRL9m1Ukgd6mHCxVJBKcIkDqpAoqibAbi4y4pO_77QIavtzwzmFmM9mlz62OE_isgXt2SARHoCyB-_L573v_6H9_r269Hqj-6n749VPwGiOWR7Nv6Smms1247aD9Vy0jrIlRlR9lL7KQ8oayuo11PZtBa9HomPZMQSguplrY1qu0HMpUbUaASSgwoSbanZkG1Dla2c6fNsgoCJZ49jfaWndEyl7tmjtE3JvpqG6-lpPx87Ax49i5nF0Od2M6RQ8P2dmtMBDx_9tRsQ9FbvW65jtvDJ2fq2XG5unCpk-UcQz6y6LwX_yfHnY0FmoLZALsDGe2TdpcANIn3SRISXwZvF7d7oOk10BMWywe6swTs_u0hAk2qU0a17UCCkAbqATvt4x7KobWAHVuzM7twAZoK77bicUl3t20udz0ocXkuY6L_HwAA__9k-5Js)

name: Hill Harper
subject: I’m offering voters something totally different
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
Because business as usual in Washington is NOT working for us.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1145%2E62735%2EP8yVh3)
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1215?t=2&akid=1145%2E62735%2EP8yVh3)
**[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1215?t=3&akid=1145%2E62735%2EP8yVh3)**
Peter, I’ve been saying for a long time that it's time for a change in Washington. **We need fresh faces, new ideas, and real solutions to our problems — not more broken promises from out-of-touch politicians.**
Seriously, we’ve given them our time, our money, our votes, and for what? Political gamesmanship? Party politics? More gridlock and embarrassing government shutdown fights? All the while, working families are struggling to make ends meet every month and plan for their futures.
So I’m bringing a new perspective to the table: one of a single father, small business owner, cancer survivor, and union organizer who has walked in the shoes of everyday Americans. **And as a first-time candidate, I'm committed to bringing real change to our communities:**
* 👉🏾 I’ll fight to **pass the PRO Act** and strengthen workers’ collective bargaining rights
* 👉🏾 I’ll work to **enshrine abortion access** into federal law
* 👉🏾 I’ll vote to **overturn the Senate filibuster** and finally pave the way for progress
* 👉🏾 I’m committed to **getting dark money out of politics** and cleaning up corruption

But Peter, this much is certain: Without your support, we’ll send the same old establishment politicians back to Washington this year, and it’ll be business as usual. **That’s why I’m counting on folks like you — not those corporate PACs and federal lobbyists — to help me win this race and put our country back on track.**
**[Together, we can deliver the kind of leadership that puts people and communities first. Please, chip in just $5 (or more!) to grow our people-powered campaign and secure the future we deserve.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1215?amount=5&t=4&akid=1145%2E62735%2EP8yVh3)**

subject: VICTORY ALERT: Cleaner vehicles, safer climate, and cleaner air -- all thanks to YOU.
body:
Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding a judiciary that works for people and our planet.

Tell Congress to Rein in the Supreme Court

The Supreme Court just heard arguments in two key cases that threaten the EPA's and other agencies' ability to protect the people from big business.

Congress must stop MAGA judges' right-wing power grab. Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding that Congress rein in the Supreme Court and urgently prioritize confirming pro-environment, pro-democracy judges. https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzsV_P3_

Peter - the Supreme Court just heard arguments in two critical cases - Relentless, Inc. v. Department of Commerce and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo - that could gut the federal government's authority to enforce even the most basic environmental protections.

In both cases, corporate interests backed by big oil are suing in order to hamstring federal agencies' authority to protect people from powerful special interests. If these plaintiffs get their way, it would move authority over every area of public policy from public-interest agencies like the EPA to the MAGA-dominated federal courts.

In the last two years, extremist Justices on the Supreme Court have already severely limited the federal government's ability to regulate climate pollution from power plants, stripped Clean Water Act protections from most of the wetlands in the United States, and overturned Roe v. Wade. Some even take lavish gifts like private jet flights from the same billionaires bringing cases like this for them to rule on. Now, they're looking to overturn a bedrock doctrine of the American legal system in order to increase their own power.

Our planet and our communities are counting on us - we need your help to make our voices heard. We're asking 5,000 LCV members to take action before midnight tonight. Tell Congress to take action to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies with pro-environment, pro-democracy judges before it's too late >> https://links.messages.lcv.

These critical cases target what's called the Chevron Doctrine. This longstanding Supreme Court precedent says that when something is unclear in a federal law administered by an expert agency, such as the way the EPA administers the Clean Air Act, federal courts should defer to agency experts' reasonable interpretations of what the law means. The Chevron Doctrine is critical to enforcing the laws that protect our environment and our communities from pollution and other harms. It touches every issue, from climate to democracy to healthcare, reproductive rights, consumer protection, workers' rights, student debt, and so much more.

Put simply, if the Supreme Court rules in favor of the plaintiffs in Relentless and Loper Bright, it will gut the ability of federal agencies like the EPA to implement the laws Congress passes, transferring that power to unelected right-wing judges. And if Congress doesn't act, far-right judges will keep control of our Supreme Court, and keep rolling back our rights, for decades to come.

Congress must stop this MAGA power grab. We need lawmakers to pass the Judiciary Act to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court. They must also pass the Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency (SCERT) Act to ensure our nation's highest court doesn't have the lowest ethical standards. And we need the Senate to prioritize confirming President Biden's pro-environment, pro-democracy judicial nominees to every vacancy on the federal bench.

We can rein in corrupt MAGA judges, Peter, but it will only happen if our movement joins together to demand it. Please, take action right now. Tell Congress to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies. It only takes a moment to help us reach our goal >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYfDw~

Thank you for joining LCV's campaign for a democracy that works for our planet and for our communities.

Onward,

Doug Lindner
Senior Director of Judiciary & Democracy
League of Conservation Voters

Friends,
The Biden Administration has spent the last three years completely surrendering the sovereignty of our country. Millions of people have crossed the southern border illegally. It is a government-sponsored invasion of America.
Biden's border calamity has turned every state into a border state. It's led to illegals overrunning communities all across America as tax dollars are used to resettle them. Tragically, it's even lead to deaths such as 22-year-old Georgia nursing student Laken Riley.
With every level of the federal government doing nothing to stop the border catastrophe, the onus has fallen on state leaders with courage to step up and take charge. Texas became the first state to step up and pass a law allowing state police to arrest illegals and remove them from the country. The Biden Administration sued to stop them-- but lost.
State Freedom Caucuses are now taking charge to pass legislation modeled after Texas. In Louisiana, Freedom Caucus member Sen. Valarie Hodges has drafted legislation that would create a crime of illegal trespass, allowing state police to arrest suspected illegal aliens and began the deportation process.
Read more about Valarie's bill in [Fox News](https://substack.com/redirect/0a7277e9-0222-4495-b765-3e1757c40a2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
In Arizona, AZFC member Rep. Alex Kolodin is leading the charge to put Texas-style border legislation on the 2024 ballot in order to get around a certain veto from Democrat Gov. Katie Hobbs. Arizonans should pay attention whether their Republican leaders in the legislature will bring it up for a vote.
[Watch him speak about it on the House floor](https://substack.com/redirect/64a65211-023b-419f-a7f8-496505eed881?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [read more about the bill in Fox News.](https://substack.com/redirect/a3e88ab8-c1da-4dec-bed6-54f4dc949f01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**South Carolina**
It's been a banner last few weeks in South Carolina with many different conservative victories. The House of Reps. [recently passed](https://substack.com/redirect/390f31a5-ea75-4672-a3bc-e9b109a769f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) SCFC member Rep. Josiah Magnuson's bill to ban Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) programs at all of the state's taxpayer-funded colleges and universities.
DEI does nothing but elevate mediocrity while punishing merit on the basis of race and tax dollars should not be funding the overpaid DEI bureaucracies at America's universities.
Additionally, South Carolina (finally) became the 29th state to adopt constitutional carry. Your 2nd amendment rights are non-negotiable and state Freedom Caucuses will always fight to protect them.
[Watch SCFC Chairman Adam Morgan speak about it on the House floor.](https://substack.com/redirect/d681f38d-ad8d-42b4-bac9-bf9589bbdf90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Wyoming**
Despite the WY Freedom Caucus's loud opposition, the Wyoming legislature recently adjourned after passing the largest budget in the state's history. But the WYFC also wanted a special session to override RINO Gov. Mark Gordon's vetoes on common sense conservative legislation, such as his vetos of property tax cuts, repeal of gun-free zones, and a bill that would allow Wyoming to fight the Biden Administration on land-grab issues.
Naturally, the RINO-infested Cowboy State legislature had no interest in actually delivering on conservative victories for their constituents. Despite Freedom Caucus pressure, a vote on a special session [failed](https://substack.com/redirect/77760fdc-1a70-4559-afd2-a72979a38515?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to get a majority vote in either the House or Senate.
As we've talked about before, Wyoming may have a supermajority Republican legislature but when you look at the voting records of those Republicans, liberals are actually running the show. Once again they've screwed over the people who elected them.
**Stateline Article**
Finally, a great profile of the State Freedom Caucus Network was published this week in [Stateline News,](https://substack.com/redirect/f044f321-92e4-481c-a441-204f398fef50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) even though they are a liberal news outlet that certainly was not on our side. But left-wing media can't help but marvel at the rise of State Freedom Caucuses and how quickly they've been able to attain grassroots support.
The article does a great job of laying out our strategy, our success, and how we're able to draw attention to important issues.
[Read the article here.](https://substack.com/redirect/f044f321-92e4-481c-a441-204f398fef50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Keep fighting,
**Andy Roth**
_President
State Freedom Caucus Network_

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38818%2E3422442%2EiYHrJh)
Derek,
You may have noticed that the emails I’m sending you these days look a little different and now say “Truth to Power” at the top.
**I started Truth to Power in 2020 to enact real change in Washington by helping elect leaders who aren’t beholden to corporate PAC contributions.** Although my time in Congress will come to an end in January, I am still fully committed to creating the change in Washington that the American people deserve.
We can only take bold action on climate change, force billionaires to pay their fair share, and address the housing affordability crisis if we diminish the influence that big corporations have over politicians.
That’s why I’m proud to support candidates who reject corporate PAC contributions in must-win races across the country. But I need your help.
_**In order to support Democrats and help us plan for the long term, will you make a monthly contribution of any amount today? Here’s a personalized link for you to make your sustaining contribution.**_

The real race begins right now, and it's going to be a tough fight. But don't worry – I've been an underdog my whole life. I know what it takes to beat the odds and win a tough fight.
I'm a 4th generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom who sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. I never knew my dad but thanks to my community of teachers, coaches and counselors at the YMCA, who helped my mom, aunt and uncle raise me, I had the opportunity to chase my version of the American Dream.
Without them, I never would've made it to the NFL, gone to law school, become a civil rights lawyer, served in the Obama Administration, or run against a 22-year GOP incumbent and won, becoming the first Democrat to ever represent TX-32 in Congress.
**And thanks to them, I am where I am today: the official Democratic nominee who has the chance to become Texas’ first Black Senator.** The chance to finally defeat Ted Cruz and give Texans the committed leadership we deserve.
With experts calling Ted Cruz the most vulnerable GOP senator in the country and two polls showing us TIED, the only thing that could hold us back is resources.

subject: Are you tired?
body:
It doesn’t have to be this way
Dear Fellow American,

Are you tired of being told that everything is going fine in America today?

It's a big lie. It's a lie being told by Adam Schiff and Joe Biden (one of many) to stay in power. And it's a lie that good people like you are ALWAYS forced to pay the price for.

But it doesn't have to be that way.

Opening our borders is a **CHOICE**.

Siding with violent criminals over our brave police is a **CHOICE**.

Spending our country into an oblivion of debt and inflation is a **CHOICE**.

Allowing homelessness and addiction to render our streets and neighborhoods unsafe is a **CHOICE**.

Accepting failed public schools is a **CHOICE**.

And the ones making these "choices" for a combined 79 years in office?

_**That would be Adam Schiff and Joe Biden.**_

**Eight decades is enough.**

Heck, in my baseball days, you wouldn't be given eight innings with such pathetic performance before you'd be sent packing to the minor leagues.

Well, that's what you and I need to do to Schiff + Biden on November 5th.

Minnesotans count on the United States Postal Service to deliver for them every day. But recently, it hasn’t, and I’m calling on Postmaster General Louis DeJoy to make sure the Postal Service has the resources to deliver mail. We must give postal workers the pay, benefits, and hours they deserve. **[If you’re with me, add your name to my petition today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82638668/465899866/1805625171?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240408_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODZiZmRjNC1mOWY1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jmH3l46-NmLNnSqT73ZTJ75-ufZlQUqj1fr__Ho-DSw=&emci=34cf45bc-f9f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=c86bfdc4-f9f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=6227932)** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82638669/465899867/1805625171?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240408_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODZiZmRjNC1mOWY1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jmH3l46-NmLNnSqT73ZTJ75-ufZlQUqj1fr__Ho-DSw=&emci=34cf45bc-f9f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=c86bfdc4-f9f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=6227932)

From delayed mail service to overworked mail carriers in Minnesota, I am deeply concerned about the state of the USPS under Louis DeJoy — and I’m calling on him to answer for these concerns.
I recently wrote an op-ed about the Postal Service. My whole life, my mom counted on the post office to deliver her hometown’s newspaper from Indiana. No matter where she lived in the US, she received that paper — the USPS delivered.
Nowadays, too many Minnesotans aren’t receiving the same quality service they deserve. Rural communities are especially affected by delayed mail.
And postal workers are bearing a massive burden — long hours, ever-increasing package deliveries, and so much more. They deserve better, too.
**I’m working hard in the Senate to get to the bottom of this worsening service. I’ve called for audits of the USPS’ Minnesota-North Dakota District, and I’m working with Senator Klobuchar to pass the _Postal Delivery Accountability Act._**
**[If you support my efforts to improve the USPS — for its employees and for the millions of Americans who count on its services — add your name to my petition today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82638670/465899868/1805625171?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240408_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODZiZmRjNC1mOWY1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jmH3l46-NmLNnSqT73ZTJ75-ufZlQUqj1fr__Ho-DSw=&emci=34cf45bc-f9f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=c86bfdc4-f9f5-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=6227932)**

name: Team Cornel West 2024
subject: Get Your Red Beret Now to Support Medicare for All - Let's Start Healing US
body:
Support Medicare for All with a beautiful, volunteer-knitted red beret \- let's get to work on Healing US

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=_QNNQW2tAN4twyqSMXtPZZvwqqdGyWWNdWLXNho8-dk&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, **As the[Healing Us documentary screens this week](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_vigil?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=2), you can now show your solidarity for health justice reform and call for Medicare for All with a hand-knitted red beret!** Dr. West has stated plainly that Health Justice is a national security issue and Medicare for All stands as a key justice pillar in his campaign. Now is the time to show your support for this critical cause. All custom red berets are hand knit by super volunteer Laura Fielding. Laura founded the grassroots coalition _**Red Berets Medicare for All** , _is an Associate Producer of _**Healing US**_ , a Love Warrior for Truth, Justice and Love, and a supporter of Cornel West for President 2024! Berets are crafted with a variety of fibers, require only hand washing, and look amazing worn in the spirit of Brother West's reminder: **“Justice is what love looks like in public!”**
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=3 "GET YOUR RED BERET TODAY IN SUPPORT OF HEALTH JUSTICE!") [GET YOUR RED BERET TODAY IN SUPPORT OF HEALTH JUSTICE!](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=3)
---
# RED BERET CHOICES
|
## **1.** **Truth, Justice, and Love******
Inspired by Brother West and his invitation for all of us to “join the band!!” Includes Button! $50.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=4)
---
## **2.** **Keep It Funky!**
The energy was palpable in Portland, Or! Knit with love and gratitude for the laughter and the music! Button Included! $99.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=5)
## **3\. Love Supreme!**
A tribute to Brother West and Love Warriors!
There are two of these berets because as Scott Desnoyers says, “No One Fights Alone!” We support each other in service to Truth, Justice and Love! Button included! $60.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=6)
## **4\. Danny Strong!**
Scott Desnoyers is Healing Us with Love in Action! Solidarity is at the heart of every action he shows up for! This beret includes a Walk for Suicide Prevention button and a hand-carved healthcare solidarity pin both made by Scott. Please donate generously for this humble beret. $99.00 or more if you feel moved to do so! [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=7)
## **5\. Justice For All**
The founding of a grassroots party grounded in Truth, Justice and Love, with purposeful intentionality and care in solidarity with “The Least of These,” is an enormous undertaking! This giant beret is knit honor of so many beautiful people! Includes JFA button! $75.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=8)
## **6\. A** **Humble Hat**
**_“To be humble is to be so sure of one’s self and one’s mission that one can forego calling excessive attention to one’s self and status.”_** ~Cornel West, Race Matters There are two of these humble berets. They are very simple to knit, as berets go, but they were absolutely knit with love! Button included because Assembly IS Required! $27.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=9)
## **7\. HealingUs With Love**
With eternal gratitude to the filmmakers of _HealingUs_ ([www.healingusnetwork.com](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=3roJg6_iIM4BGAXIgjHEl35caLAGn0a3GmwIYXBlMKTNqs0rQX6_ssH-9Tu7dC0r&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=10)), and all of the Medicare for All movement — we, the 99%! Includes _HealingUs_ button, made by Scott Desnoyers $99.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=11)
## **8\. Lady Liberty**
How can we ever thank Susan Sarandon enough, from the bottom of our hearts, for lending her powerful voice as Lady Liberty? She is Healing Us with Love! Healing Us, Lady Liberty button included! $99.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=12)
## **9\. Medicare for ALL and Beyond!**
Have you all read Brother West’s healthcare justice platform? These berets are a tribute to ‘Not Me, Us!’ We, the 99% will bring M4All. Bernie “wrote the damn bill,” but WE are the ones who must do the work of fighting on all fronts until healthcare is guaranteed as a human right to ALL! Buttons are vintage, crafted for Red Berets in 2020, included! $99.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=13)
## **10\. With These Hands!**
Red Berets Medicare for All send love, and deep gratitude to Senator Nina Turner and Dr. Victoria Dooley for donning our craftivism for healthcare justice during Bernie 2020, and for always lifting and amplifying the grassroots! “With These Hands, we WILL have Medicare for All! With These Hands!!” Knitters and crocheters, join us in the round! “HELLO SOMEBODY!”~Nina Includes Red Berets unique button from 2020 $99.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=14)
## **11\. Solidarity through the States!**
Whole Washington deserves an enormous debt of gratitude and due credit for so much of what shines through in Healing Us! National Single Payer is the destination—we must get there! And we should always remember that the groundswell to make it possible comes from supporting each others’ work! Unique button, is thanks to Kathryn Lewandowsky, RN. (Included)! $75.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=15)
## **12\. Knit for Nurses and the 99%!**
This very special twirl top tam is crafted with the same care and love for all of the nurses out there that each one of them put into the Medicare for All movement. They are very much the heart of single payer solidarity. The tireless work and advocacy they put in, fighting on all fronts to see healthcare justice legislation passed is astounding. We love you, nurses! Thank you for everything you do! We are with you! Thank you for Healing Us With Love! $75.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=16)
## **13\. Force The Vote!**
Outrageous cost of the profit motive spinning out of control...?! It’s NOT complicated. FORCE THE VOTE for Truth, Justice and Love! Inspired in good faith by Briahna Joy Gray and Alex Coronado, our incredible #CornelWest2024 volunteer coordinator! Includes Justice For All button. $50.00 [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=17)
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=18 "GET YOUR RED BERET TODAY IN SUPPORT OF HEALTH JUSTICE!") [GET YOUR RED BERET TODAY IN SUPPORT OF HEALTH JUSTICE!](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/healingus_red_berets?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=red_berets_healing_us_medicare&n=18)
---
**Please gather the courage to stand with us in this urgent moment and help us build a more just and equitable future for all.** In service and solidarity, **Team Cornel West for President 2024
[CornelWest2024.com](CornelWest2024.com)**
---
Cornel West for President · 8253A Backlick Rd., PO Box #1577, Newington, VA 22122, United States

help me win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue
| | |
---
Friend, I'm sorry to start this email with bad news, but I don't have anywhere else to turn.
**New polling shows this Ohio race is still tight, which is not where we want to be in a race that could decide Senate control.**
The good news is there's still time to right the ship – but we must act NOW. I set a personal goal to raise $100,000, and I'm counting on you to help us get there by midnight: [**Please, friend, will you split $5 or more right now between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand to help me win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82639828/465904003/-431201696?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk4940-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGRiY2VmNi1mZGY1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BiNJKp7sVpFuNc1p8GmXrWMWfExVpHCq1z3piSQRifw=)

Peter,
As the proverb goes, _“a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.”_ Exactly one year ago today, our campaign took that first step. Since then, I’ve literally walked more than 1,000 miles, knocked on thousands of doors, and worn out two pairs of shoes.
[Before I share some reflections, I want to ask you to make a special anniversary contribution to fuel our campaign’s work over the next months. Defeating my opponent, David Schweikert, will be a challenge, but I know it’s one we can accomplish if we work together.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82640038/465904764/-761994045?refcode=AU_AHC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240408_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTg5ZjZiZTItMDBmNi1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=NHi0yZKXcP0IhOYOuhx7wbyTwyL4kbhLViw-QeOcyWA=)
Launching my campaign to represent AZ-01 one year ago today was not a decision I made easily or took lightly, but I did it hoping there would be folks who would join me and fight for the future of our democracy.
**I have been so grateful and moved in this journey to know that, at every step, I have not walked alone.**
Because of the helping hand of thousands of people, our grassroots movement has shattered all expectations and done what no other Congressional campaign in America and no other congressional campaign in Arizona history has been able to do — all thanks to your support, Peter.
As the grandson of four Holocaust survivors and son of refugees from communism, democracy and freedom aren’t abstract to me, they’ve always been real.
My opponent in this campaign sees the world differently. **I’m running for Congress to restore what I call The Michigan Dream:** that if you work hard, you can own a home, pay your bills, put a little away for retirement, and maybe drive your family to Disney World every now and then.

I know this dream firsthand. Growing up in Portland, my dad worked construction, often clocking in 70 to 80 hours a week. When the construction season slowed down and it got cold, he worked snow removal to make ends meet. Like many people in this district, he showered at the end of his work day, not before it. Dad wasn’t afraid to get calluses on his hands through a tough day’s work. Thanks to him and my mom, my sisters and I were the first in our family to go to college, and I have been working to uplift families like ours ever since.

**Unfortunately, today, the Michigan Dream has become out-of-reach for too many Michiganders.** Combine that with extremists making us less safe by trying to take away the right to abortion and refusing to address the epidemic of gun violence, and it’s clear that we need to send real leaders to D.C. who we can trust to solve problems our community faces.

I have spent my adult life fighting to make it just a little easier for working families, like the one I grew up in, to achieve the Michigan Dream. Throughout my career and now in the state Senate, I’ve helped improve employment and educational opportunities for children across our state, pass historic tax cuts for working families, and enact public policy that’s helped level the playing field.

**I’m running for Congress because I am ready to help give hardworking families across the Great Lakes Bay Region the tools to succeed.**

clean_body: My name is Kristen McDonald Rivet. I’m a Michigan state Senator, lifelong advocate for kids and families, and proud mom of 6. And I’m running for Congress in Michigan’s 8th District. = = My name is Kristen McDonald Rivet. I’m a Michigan state Senator, lifelong advocate for kids and families, and proud mom of 6. And I’m running for Congress in Michigan’s 8th District. Experts say this race is a pure tossup after Democratic Rep. Dan Kildee announced his retirement, so I’m going to need your help to build a winning campaign. = | | = I’m running for Congress to restore what I call The Michigan Dream: that if you work hard, you can own a home, pay your bills, put a little away for retirement, and maybe drive your family to Disney World every now and then. I know this dream firsthand. Growing up in Portland, my dad worked construction, often clocking in 70 to 80 hours a week. When the construction season slowed down and it got cold, he worked snow removal to make ends meet. Like many people in this district, he showered at the end of his work day, not before it. Dad wasn’t afraid to get calluses on his hands through a tough day’s work. Thanks to him and my mom, my sisters and I were the first in our family to go to college, and I have been working to uplift families like ours ever since. Unfortunately, today, the Michigan Dream has become out-of-reach for too many Michiganders. Combine that with extremists making us less safe by trying to take away the right to abortion and refusing to address the epidemic of gun violence, and it’s clear that we need to send real leaders to D.C. who we can trust to solve problems our community faces. I have spent my adult life fighting to make it just a little easier for working families, like the one I grew up in, to achieve the Michigan Dream. Throughout my career and now in the state Senate, I’ve helped improve employment and educational opportunities for children across our state, pass historic tax cuts for working families, and enact public policy that’s helped level the playing field.
